多智能体系统

[MA-0] Can LLM s Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在未知物理规律的模拟环境中，能否自主发现异常现象并基于实验探究揭示隐藏物理定律的能力问题。其核心挑战在于评估模型是否具备类人科学探索能力——即在未被明确指示研究目标的情况下，通过观察、提出假设、设计实验与迭代验证，识别出与常规物理相悖的规律。解决方案的关键在于构建名为LongChang的自动化框架，该框架可生成具有非标准物理法则的虚拟世界，并让多个独立的LLM代理协同完成“场景生成-工具设计-实验执行-结果评估”的闭环探索流程。其中，各代理分别负责生成实验场景、评审工具构型、验证报告正确性及依据探索记录引导后续演化，从而实现无需人工干预的自主科学研究循环。实验结果显示，仅有GPT-6-Astra实现了16.7%的发现率，其余模型均未能成功识别异常规律，表明当前主流大语言模型在跨域推理与系统性科学探索方面仍存在显著局限。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37649
作者: Zhen Yang,Wen Wang,Xander Xu,Ying-Cong Chen
机构: HKUST(GZ)(香港科技大学(广州)); ZJU(浙江大学); Alibaba Group(阿里巴巴集团); HKUST(香港科技大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Scientific discovery often begins with an unexpected observation that prompts a new research question. In a world with altered physical laws, can large language models (LLMs) notice unexpected behavior, such as heavier objects falling more slowly, and discover the law through experiments without being told what to investigate? To evaluate this ability, we introduce LongChang, an automated framework that creates simulated worlds with altered physics, where one or more laws differ from ordinary physics. The evaluated LLMs act as explorers, manipulating objects and building tools to investigate their own questions without research tasks or hints about these laws. Separate LLM agents generate and review scenes, review tool designs, and evaluate reports for correctness and experimental support using the altered physical laws and exploration records. These records guide scene evolution for further exploration, allowing the full cycle to run without human intervention. Among 12 LLMs, GPT-6-Astra achieves a discovery rate of 16.7%, while the other 11 score 0%. The exploration records reveal uninvestigated anomalies and only partial identification of the altered physical laws.

[MA-1] Rare Relevant and Still Wrong: How Memory Fails LLM Group Decisions

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）群体讨论在压缩为短时记忆供最终决策者使用时，如何有效选择保留信息的问题。核心挑战在于：在“隐藏特征任务”（hidden-profile tasks）中，事实的普遍性（即被多少参与者持有）与其实用性存在混淆，导致常规启发式策略失效。现有两种自然启发式——优先保留罕见事实（rarest-first）或保留与决策标准相关事实（relevance-based）——均在特定情境下表现不佳。研究提出CrossProfile基准测试，通过60个模板生成480个任务，系统性地分离事实归属与文本内容，验证了两种启发式在预测性失败中的局限性：基于相关性的选择会引入误导性“干扰项”（decoy），而基于稀有性的选择仅在罕见事实恰好为有用信息时才有效，整体表现接近随机。实验表明，决策模型的准确性取决于记忆中证据的平衡分布，而非选择策略本身。此外，研究发现决策模型还受“社会证明”（social proof）机制干扰，即对来自多名代理的事实赋予过高权重；移除或随机重分配归属标签后，准确率提升13至24分。更关键的是，在真实讨论场景中，完整对话记录的准确率甚至低于无笔记状态，说明原始证据在记忆压缩前已严重损耗。因此，解决方案的关键不在于优化记忆选择规则，而在于重构信息传递机制，避免早期信息失真。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37624
作者: Anouar Imel,Imad Charradi,Abderrahman Sghir,Khalil El Khammar
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Social and Information Networks (cs.SI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:When an LLM group’s discussion is compressed into a short memory for a final decision maker, what should the memory keep? Two natural heuristics keep the rarest claims or the claims relevant to the decision criteria. On hidden-profile tasks both look attractive, because how widely a fact is held is confounded with whether it helps. We introduce CrossProfile, a diagnostic benchmark of 60 templates with automatically verified answer keys, in which the ownership of supporting, decoy, and irrelevant facts is crossed while their text is held fixed (480 tasks). Across Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and two DeepSeek models, both heuristics fail in predictable places. Selecting by relevance readmits decoys, because decoys are on topic: even a perfect relevance filter loses 23 to 31 points to rarest-first selection in the classic hidden-profile configuration. Rarest-first selection is no better than random selection on average and wins only where the rare facts happen to be the useful ones. In both cases accuracy follows the balance of evidence the memory keeps, not the policy that kept it. The decision model adds a third failure, a form of social proof: it gives extra weight to facts attributed to many agents. Removing the attribution tags, or reassigning them at random with line order fixed, raises accuracy in the classic configuration by 13 to 24 points. In natural discussions the evidence is lost before any memory acts: the complete transcript yields lower accuracy than no notes at all.

[MA-2] ANDEM: Balancing Centralized and Decentralized Critics to Address the Information Gap in Complex Multi-Agent Environments

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在集中式训练、分布式执行（CTDE）框架下，多智能体强化学习中因训练与执行阶段信息不一致所导致的“信息鸿沟”问题。具体而言，在训练时，中心化评论家（centralized critic）可访问全局状态，而执行时各智能体仅能基于局部观测进行决策，这种信息不对称在部分可观测性、观测噪声以及任务与智能体动态开放（TAO）场景下尤为显著。现有方法通常单向转移中心化指导，仅一次移除或蒸馏评论家，导致策略在训练过程中始终依赖不可用的全局信息，缺乏在无中心化支持下自主决策的充分练习。本文提出TANDEM框架，其核心在于保留一个中心化评论家，并在每个训练步骤中以两种方式读取：一是从全局状态的中心化读取，二是基于各智能体执行时实际可用信息的去中心化读取。通过一个无参数门控机制对两种读取结果进行比较，仅在二者一致时采用去中心化读取进行策略优化，而在局部视图误导时重新启用中心化读取；同时引入共享目标，将去中心化读取逐步拉近至中心化读取。该方法形式化为任务-智能体开放的去中心化部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（TAO-Dec-POMDP），并在三个独立隔离信息鸿沟不同来源的协作任务（部分可观测性、观测噪声、火灾扑救中的开放性）上验证。实验表明，TANDEM在九个设置中表现最优，且在所有情况下均不显著劣于任一基线方法，证明其有效缓解了训练与执行间的信息不对称问题。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37592
作者: Alireza Saleh Abadi,Leen-Kiat Soh,Adam Eck,Prashant Doshi
机构: University of Nebraska-Lincoln(内布拉斯加大学林肯分校); Oberlin College(欧柏林学院); University of Georgia(佐治亚大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning under centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE) shapes decentralized policies with a centralized critic that observes the global state, then removes the critic at execution. The policies are optimized to rely on information they will not have when they act, an information gap between training and execution. It widens under partial observability, observation noise, and openness, where the set of agents and tasks present changes during an episode. Existing methods transfer centralized guidance in one direction only, removing or distilling the critic once, so the policies never rehearse acting without the critic while they can still be corrected. We propose TANDEM, which keeps one centralized critic and reads it two ways at each training step: a centralized read from the global state, and a decentralized read restricted to the information each agent will have at execution. A parameter-free gate compares the two reads for each agent and trains the policy on the decentralized read where they agree, reinstating the centralized read only where the local view is misleading. A shared target pulls the decentralized read toward the centralized one. We formalize the setting as a task- and agent-open decentralized partially observable Markov decision process (TAO-Dec-POMDP) and evaluate TANDEM on three cooperative domains, each isolating one form of the information gap: discovery for partial observability, sampling for observation noise, and openness in wildfire suppression. We compare against six CTDE baselines and ablate the gate and the shared target; the supplementary material holds the full variant sweep, diagnostics, and learning curves. We measure return at execution, once the centralized critic is removed. TANDEM is the best method on eight of the nine setups and never significantly worse than any baseline.

[MA-3] Strategyproof Deep Reinforcement Learning for Online Resource Allocation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在线资源分配中的两个耦合挑战：在需求不确定的条件下高效分配稀缺资源，以及确保参与方真实申报任务估值与资源需求（即保证策略无关性，strategyproofness）。传统强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）虽能通过经验自适应调整分配策略，但无法保证策略无关性；现有策略无关的强化学习方法采用线性分配规则，限制了对复杂资源交互关系的建模能力。而神经机制设计方法虽具备更强的表达能力，却仅能提供近似的激励相容保障。针对上述问题，本文提出首个用于在线资源分配的策略无关深度强化学习机制，其核心创新在于三个关键组件：(i) 一种构造性单调神经网络，通过强制非线性交互结构满足单调性约束（更高申报价值不会降低接受概率，更长申报时长或更大资源需求不会提高接受概率）；(ii) 一种广义临界支付机制，即在其他输入固定时，最低被接受的申报价值作为支付标准；(iii) 采用强化学习或对已有规则进行模仿学习的方式进行训练。其中，单调性与临界支付共同保障了策略无关性和个体理性，而神经网络结构则赋予模型灵活性，模仿学习显著提升了训练效率。实验表明，在一个包含四类资源及两组合作方的流式场景中，该神经规则达到离线最优福利的97.8%，优于线性学习器（93.8%）和先到先服务（89.0%），分别缩小了65%和80%的最优性差距；且模仿学习仅需261秒即可达到97.5%的性能，相较传统强化学习提速约89倍。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37504
作者: Fariba Dehghan,Sebastian Stein,Vahid Yazdanpanah,Stephanie Gauthier
机构: University of Southampton (南安普顿大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Science and Game Theory (cs.GT)
备注: 15 pages, 2 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Online resource allocation faces two coupled challenges: (1) allocating scarce resources efficiently under uncertain future demand, and (2) ensuring that agents report task valuations and requirements truthfully (strategyproofness). Reinforcement Learning (RL) adapts allocation decisions through experience but does not necessarily ensure strategyproofness. Existing strategyproof RL uses a linear allocation rule, which limits the resource interactions it can represent. Neural mechanism design methods offer greater expressiveness, but provide only approximate incentive guarantees. Against this background, we introduce the first strategyproof deep RL mechanism for online resource allocation. It integrates three novel components: (i) a monotonic neural network that learns nonlinear interactions by construction (higher reported value cannot reduce acceptance, while a longer reported duration or larger resource requirement cannot increase it); (ii) a generalised critical payment: the lowest accepted value, with all other inputs fixed; and (iii) training by either RL or imitation of an existing rule. Together, monotonicity and the critical payment ensure strategyproofness and individual rationality, while the neural rule provides flexibility and imitation improves training efficiency. Empirically, on a four-resource stream with two partner pairs that a linear difference cannot represent, the neural rule achieves 97.8% of an offline welfare upper bound, compared with 93.8% for a linear learner and 89.0% for first-come, first-served, closing 65% and 80% of the remaining optimality gap, respectively. Moreover, imitation reaches 97.5% in only 261 seconds, about 89 times faster than RL.

[MA-4] Concordat: Typed Sessions for LLM Agents

【速读】：该论文旨在解决基于大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）的智能体在执行具有实际影响的操作（如取消预订、退款、账户修改等）时，因缺乏强制性行为约束而导致的不可靠合规问题。现有方法依赖模型在提示（prompt）中遵循规则，但其执行可靠性完全取决于模型自身的选择，难以保证关键安全规则（如“更改前需获得客户明确确认”）被严格执行。为此，论文提出Concordat——一个基于有限状态协议（finite-state protocol）的Python库，将智能体建模为具有明确定义状态转换接口的对象，借鉴类型态（typestate）与会话类型（session types）的思想，在运行时强制执行协议逻辑。其核心解决方案在于：在每一轮交互中，仅向模型提供当前协议状态下合法的工具调用，非法调用在执行前即被拒绝，避免产生副作用；关键决策权保留给人类，只能请求而无法自动执行；同时对令牌消耗和工具调用预算进行跨状态转移的线性分配与追踪。协议在定义时即进行静态验证，且子类若可能绕过父类协议，则会被拒绝，实现了行为层面的里氏替换原则（Liskov substitution）。在tau-bench的50个航空任务评估中，面对模拟客户的压力，标准代理在GPT-4.1下有13次、Claude Haiku 5.5下有29次未获确认即执行变更，而Concordat代理零违规，且任务成功率无显著差异。此外，tau-bench的奖励机制未能检测到多数违规行为。Concordat已开源。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37461
作者: Milad Sikaroudi
机构: 独立研究者(Independent Researcher)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 11 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Code, benchmark harness and results: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Agents built on large language models are increasingly allowed to take consequential actions: cancelling bookings, issuing refunds, changing accounts. The rules that govern those actions, such as “obtain the customer’s explicit confirmation before changing anything”, are usually stated in the prompt and followed only as reliably as the model chooses to follow them. We present Concordat, a Python library that treats an agent as an object whose interface is a finite-state protocol, in the spirit of typestate and session types, and enforces that protocol on the model at run time. On every turn the model is offered only the tools that are legal in the current protocol state, calls outside that set are rejected before they have side effects, decisions reserved for humans can only be requested, and token and tool-call budgets are charged and split linearly across handoffs. Protocols are checked when they are defined, and a subclass of an agent is rejected if it could bypass its parent’s protocol, a behavioural form of Liskov substitution. We evaluate a Concordat agent against the standard agent of tau-bench on its 50 airline tasks, adding simulated customers who pressure the agent to skip confirmation. The standard agent made changes without the required “yes” in 13 of 50 tasks with gpt-4.1 and in 29 of 128 task-runs with Claude Haiku 5.5; the Concordat agent made none, with no significant difference in task success. tau-bench’s own reward did not detect most of these violations. Concordat is open source.

[MA-5] st-Time Communication in Trading Agent Swarms

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在缺乏共同目标与即时明确反馈的复杂环境中，多智能体系统（multi-agent system）中通信对决策一致性（即“羊群效应”）的影响问题。在真实金融市场交易场景中，各智能体独立管理账户，其决策由市场延迟且噪声较大的方式评估，这使得智能体间更接近于独立决策者群体而非协同团队，因此传统意义上的收敛并非必然结果。研究通过在七天内（2026年10月1日至9日）运行来自四个模型家族的200个智能体，分组考察从隔离到共享笔记等多种通信机制下的行为演化。关键发现表明，在其中两个模型家族中，通信组相较于孤立组显著提高了成员持有的股票一致性；群体收益主要取决于成员共持资产的表现。进一步分析显示，看到同伴发布的消息会使智能体重用其八词短语的概率提升7个百分点，而当智能体因位置相近无法直接接收信息时，仍存在14%的相同输入出现率，表明部分一致性源于初始条件而非通信。值得注意的是，单日交易行为并未因阅读消息而发生显著变化，但跨日追踪显示通信组在持仓和决策规则采纳上表现出更强的同步性。由此揭示：评估羊群效应需以无同伴交互的基线为参照，以识别超出随机一致性的“超额收敛”。该研究的核心解决方案在于构建可量化、可追踪的通信-行为关联框架，从而揭示非协作环境下通信如何驱动隐性协调与系统性风险积累。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37448
作者: Avid Fayaz,Harry Zhang,Håvard Alstadheim,Erik Nordlöf,Vilhelm Karlin,André Silva
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 31 pages, 10 figures, 10 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Communication between agents has mostly been studied on tasks with a shared objective and fast, clear feedback. Trading has neither: each agent manages its own account, with decisions being scored by markets late and noisily. A trading swarm is thus a population of independent decision-makers rather than a team, for which convergence is a risk and not the goal. We ran 200 agents from four model families in groups of ten under five communication regimes, from isolation to message boards and shared notes, over seven US trading days (1 to 9 October 2026), logging everything each agent read before every decision. In two of the four families, communicating groups came to hold far more of the same stocks than the isolated group. A group’s return was largely the return on what its members held in common. Seeing a post from a groupmate made an agent 7 percentage points more likely to reuse an eight-word phrase from it. Agents that started too close together to see each other’s posts shared such a phrase in 14% of cases, the rate that common inputs produce. Seeing the post did not detectably change that morning’s trades. Case studies traced the adoption of positions and decision rules over subsequent days, and communicating groups sold in step more often than isolated ones. Because isolated groups also converged on the same stocks, sometimes completely, assessments of herding need to measure excess convergence relative to a no-peer baseline.

[MA-6] Agent -Conditioned Routing: Diverse Reasoning Paths Within One Frozen Model NEURIPS2026

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 在面对同一问题时倾向于重复单一求解路径，导致输出多样性不足的问题。尽管通过生成多个解法可暴露不同方法，但多数额外轨迹仍为同一主导方法的变体。其核心解决方案是提出一种无需用户指定角色、预设方法、微调或模型复制的代理条件路由（Agent-Conditioned Routing, ACR）机制，利用冻结的稀疏专家混合模型（MoE）中固有的条件容量，通过为并行生成轨迹分配持久且未训练的共享/私有专家可用性掩码（expert-eligibility masks），在保持原有输入依赖的令牌路由机制的基础上，激发模型探索多样化的求解路径。实验结果表明，在经过筛选的126道多模式数学与物理基准测试中，ACR在相同输出预算下，使至少出现两种不同主方法的题目数量分别达到GLM 5.3的2倍（37.3 vs. 18.7）和GPT-5.6 Sol的1.67倍（45.00 vs. 27.00），显著提升解法多样性；盲评审计进一步验证了其在双骨干模型上均能产生更多多方法解法，尽管正确率略低。消融实验显示，匹配的专家可用性掩码对多样性贡献有限，而基于令牌重采样的掩码则更利于提高正确率。此外，引入知情顺序提示可进一步增强多样性。整体而言，ACR仅增加约160 KiB的掩码状态开销，在三题微型基准测试中延迟与峰值显存占用均控制在批量温度采样水平的3%以内，展现出高效且轻量的实用性。

Abstract:Generating several solutions can expose alternative methods, but additional trajectories often paraphrase one dominant approach. We investigate whether the conditional capacity of a frozen sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) model can provide such diversity from one problem prompt, without user-assigned roles, prescribed methods, fine-tuning, or model copies. Agent-Conditioned Routing (ACR) assigns m parallel trajectories persistent, untrained shared/private expert-eligibility masks while preserving the learned, input-dependent token router. On a screened 126-question multi-mode mathematics and physics benchmark, with model judges reading the reported derivations in full, we count the number of problems yielding at least two distinct primary methods among soft-correct solutions in four trajectories. ACR reaches approximately twice as many such problems as the strongest temperature setting under GLM 5.3 (37.3 versus 18.7), and 1.67 times as many under GPT-5.6 Sol (45.00 versus 27.00), at matched output budgets. A blinded four-expert audit on a stratified sample of 30 problems also finds more multi-method solutions with ACR on both backbones, with lower correctness. Matched-eligibility ablations show modest multi-method count advantages for ACR, while token-resampled masks attain higher correctness. An informed sequential prompt elicits more diversity still, using previous solutions and explicit requests for alternative methods. ACR adds about 160 KiB of mask state. In a three-problem microbenchmark capped at 1,024 tokens, its latency and peak VRAM usage remain within 3% of batched temperature sampling.

[MA-7] Aligning Institutional Power and Operational Ability

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）系统在社会可持续性方面面临的规范性困境，即如何确保责任分配与主体履行能力相匹配，避免出现不可实现的期望或权力升级等规范性失衡问题。其核心解决方案在于提出一个以过程导向建模和制度性权力为核心的正式分析框架，用于评估具有规范意义的多智能体系统中的规范能力一致性；该框架通过识别操作流程与制度状态之间的对称关系，揭示规范地位生命周期的动态机制，并据此提出修复策略，从而实现对规范性设计的系统性优化。

Abstract:To be socially sustainable, Agentic AI systems require normative designs that align responsibilities with the ability to fulfil them. Identifying incongruences such as unsatisfiable expectations or privilege escalation is crucial in avoiding normative pitfalls. In this study, we discuss design dimensions suitable for describing multi-agent systems in light of this norm-ability alignment requirement. We propose a formal framework centred on process-oriented modelling and institutional power for the analysis of a given normatively relevant process, discuss strategies for repairing it, and elaborate on how the symmetrical relation between operational process and institutional state affects the lifecycle of normative positions.

[MA-8] Evaluating Priority Dispatch for Premium Membership in On-demand Taxi-sharing

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在按需出租车共享服务中引入高级会员制（premium membership）时，如何在调度层面实现可行性的问题。其核心挑战在于，在保障高级会员优先服务体验的同时，避免对普通用户造成过大的服务负担，从而维持整体系统效率与公平性。解决方案的关键在于提出两种基于调度层面的优化方法：一是针对高级会员缩短服务截止时间（deadline shortening），二是在此基础上进一步引入专用于高级会员的专属车辆（dedicated premium vehicles）。通过在三种不同需求场景下（平稳均匀需求、具有高峰时段的时间变化需求、以及集中在城市区域的高峰交通需求）基于SUMO的仿真对比分析，研究发现最优的优先级机制应根据运营条件和高级会员比例动态调整。因此，采用条件依赖的调度方法切换策略，能够在提供高级会员服务优势的同时，有效控制对非高级会员用户的负面影响，实现整体系统的优化。

Abstract:In this paper, we analyze the dispatch-level feasibility of introducing premium membership into an on-demand taxi-sharing service using a sequential optimal insertion method. We propose two dispatch-level methods: deadline shortening for premium users, and deadline shortening with dedicated premium vehicles. We compare them with a baseline dispatch method through SUMO-based simulations under three demand scenarios: steady uniform demand, time-varying demand with a peak period, and urban-focused demand with concentrated peak traffic. Our results show that the suitable priority mechanism depends on operating conditions and premium ratio, suggesting that condition-dependent method switching may provide premium benefits while keeping non-premium-user burden smaller for overall optimization.

【速读】：该论文旨在解决混合智能体（包括人类与机器）在复杂协作环境中如何实现自我治理的问题，尤其关注多智能体系统在公共资源管理、合作生存及制度选择等情境下的行为演化与治理有效性。其核心挑战在于：当人类与生成式AI（Generative AI）智能体共同参与动态决策过程时，不同动机与行为模式的智能体组合是否能形成稳定且高效的治理结构，以及这些结构如何受个体策略、互动机制与规则执行的影响。解决方案的关键在于构建一个名为Megabike的多智能体模拟器与严肃游戏平台，通过设定具有相互依赖性的竞技场环境，实现对资源分配、集体行动、政治制度选择等关键治理维度的可控实验。该平台具备全规则自动化执行、行为日志完整记录、人类与机器可任意替代任一角色的特性，从而为研究人机混合群体中的治理机制提供了可量化、可重复的测试基准。实验表明，不同智能体原型（如合作型、懒惰型、颠覆型或对抗型）的组合可能产生意料之外甚至反效果的结果，凸显了治理设计中非线性交互的重要性，进而为未来系统性地融合人类与计算智能体开展控制实验提供了可扩展的框架。

Abstract:AI agents no longer act alone: they cooperate, coordinate and compete within and between groups, increasingly alongside humans who are in, on or out of ``the loop’'. Whether such mixed groups can govern themselves is an open question about machine behaviour and human-computer interaction that needs a testbed for hybrid institutions. We present Megabike, a multi-agent simulator and serious game with interdependent arenas for common-pool resource management, cooperative survival and constitutional choice. Riders sharing a megabike must agree their arrangements for steering, pedalling and distributing resources, and their political regime, while negotiating with rival bikes and avoiding an existential threat. Every rule is enforced by the simulator, every action is logged, and any seat can be taken by a human or a machine, so governance can be studied under well-defined metrics. We demonstrate Megabike with forty sessions in which language-model riders with cooperative, lazy, subversive or opposing dispositions chose regimes, elected leaders and expelled one another. The results show that different combinations of agent archetypes could produce unexpected and counterproductive outcomes. We conclude with extensions for systematic experiments mixing human and computational agents.

[MA-10] Remembering Is Not Enough: Refining Memories and Learning When to Use Them in Multi-Agent Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）驱动的多智能体系统中记忆机制存在的两大核心问题：一是存储的经验建议可能存在缺陷，二是难以判断在特定情境下是否应使用某条记忆。传统方法仅依赖团队整体的成功或失败来评估记忆的有效性，但这一标准不可靠，容易导致错误记忆被保留或正确记忆被误用。为此，论文提出一种无需训练的框架DiscernMem，其关键在于两个创新组件：一是缺陷感知的记忆优化（Defect-Aware Memory Refinement, DMR），通过对比单条记忆与无记忆情况下的团队执行表现，识别规则缺陷，并在当前及历史任务上验证修复方案，从而提升记忆质量并防止丢失已有有效行为；二是边界学习元记忆（Boundary-Learning Meta-Memory, BLM），记录每条记忆的过往使用记录及其效果，基于任务上下文和接收消息动态学习何时应启用或回避特定记忆，实现对记忆使用的精准引导。二者协同作用，使多智能体团队能够在纠正错误经验的同时保留原本适用但被误用的有效规则。在Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507模型上针对AutoGen、CAMEL和MacNet等四个基准的实验表明，DiscernMem在多项任务中取得最高平均得分，优于最强基线0.51–4.32分，尤其在代码生成与符号规划任务中表现突出，如在CAMEL上的PDDL得分达37.71，显著超越基线的28.48。

Abstract:Memory helps LLM-based multi-agent systems reuse experience, but stored advice can be flawed or applied in the wrong situation. Team-level success or failure alone cannot reliably show whether a memory needs correction or should not have been used. We propose DiscernMem, a training-free framework that improves both memory quality and memory use. To improve quality, Defect-Aware Memory Refinement (DMR) compares team executions with a single memory and with no memory, diagnoses rule defects, and tests repairs on current and earlier tasks to guard against losing previously useful behavior. To guide appropriate use, Boundary-Learning Meta-Memory (BLM) records each memory’s past uses and effects, learning when its owner role should apply or avoid it based on task context and incoming messages. Together, these components help teams correct flawed experience while retaining useful rules that were applied incorrectly. Experiments with Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on four benchmarks show that DiscernMem achieves the highest average score on AutoGen, CAMEL, and MacNet, exceeding the strongest reported baselines by 0.51-4.32 points. It leads on code generation and symbolic planning across all three systems, including a PDDL score of 37.71 versus 28.48 on CAMEL.

[MA-11] GarmentSegAgent : Autonomous Garment Segmentation for Web Fashion Images via Textual Self-Refinement

【速读】：该论文旨在解决网络时尚图像中由于视觉异质性导致的服装分割可靠性问题，尤其针对在缺乏人工空间提示的情况下，如何自主识别并纠正特定于服装的分割错误。其核心解决方案是提出GarmentSegAgent框架，该框架通过语义规划、空间执行与视觉评估的迭代文本自精炼机制实现自主优化。关键创新在于引入CAST（Constrained Attribution-guided Selective TextGrad）方法，将视觉误差归因与定向文本优化相连接：CAST能够识别导致分割错误的指令成分，基于文本梯度选择性地更新这些成分，并结合服装特定约束验证优化后的指令。该方法在推理阶段实现图像级误差修正，同时保持基础模型参数冻结。在DeepFashion2、ModaNet和Fashionpedia数据集上的实验表明，该方法在区域重叠率和边界精度方面均取得一致提升，且优于传统TextGrad方法，展现出更强的鲁棒性。通过视觉反馈引导可控的指令更新，GarmentSegAgent为自主服装理解提供了新范式，具备在可扩展时尚内容分析、视觉检索及消费者到店铺匹配等场景中的应用潜力。

Abstract:Web fashion images support applications such as visual product search and consumer-to-shop matching, yet their visual heterogeneity makes reliable garment segmentation challenging. Despite advances in promptable segmentation, autonomously identifying and correcting garment-specific errors without human-provided spatial prompts remains difficult. We propose GarmentSegAgent, an autonomous framework that integrates semantic planning, spatial execution, and visual evaluation through iterative textual self-refinement. At its core, we introduce CAST (Constrained Attribution-guided Selective TextGrad), which connects visual error attribution with targeted textual optimization. CAST identifies instruction components responsible for segmentation errors, selectively updates them through textual gradients, and validates the resulting instructions against garment-specific constraints. This enables image-specific error correction at inference time while keeping the underlying foundation models frozen. Experiments on DeepFashion2, ModaNet, and Fashionpedia demonstrate consistent improvements in region overlap and boundary accuracy, alongside more reliable refinement than conventional TextGrad. By enabling visual feedback to guide controlled instruction updates, GarmentSegAgent offers a promising direction for autonomous garment understanding, with potential applications in scalable fashion content analysis, visual retrieval, and consumer-to-shop matching on the Web.

[MA-12] Bayesian Replicator Dynamics and the Inversion of Strict Dominance in Bimatrix Games

【速读】：该论文旨在解决演化博弈论中复制者动态（Replicator Dynamics）在不同收益函数下行为不一致的问题，特别是其在连续时间贝叶斯推理（Continuous-time Bayesian Inference）中的适用性边界。核心问题是：何种博弈结构下，复制者动态可被解释为贝叶斯更新过程？解决方案的关键在于识别出两类不同的博弈：一类是不存在严格占优策略的博弈，另一类则包含至少一个玩家具有严格占优策略的博弈。研究发现，在标准期望效用收益下，仅当博弈中无严格占优策略时，复制者动态才等价于贝叶斯更新；而采用对数收益（Logarithmic Payoff）时，这一等价性在所有两玩家博弈中均成立。这导致在存在占优策略的博弈中，两种收益定义下的动态方向相反——例如在囚徒困境中，对数收益使合作成为稳定结果，而传统收益则导致合作消失。此外，研究揭示了两类收益函数共享精确的哈密顿结构（Hamiltonian Structure），并由此提出可通过匹配硬币博弈（Matching Pennies）中周期振荡的等时性（isochrony）进行行为检验。因此，证据整合方式（即对数形式）决定了动态选择所能达到的战略均衡范围，进而影响学习近似贝叶斯更新时的演化路径。

Abstract:Replicator dynamics, the central model of evolutionary game theory, describe populations evolving under selection and agents learning by trial and error. They also admit a third use: continuous-time Bayesian inference, in which an agent planning against an opponent accumulates evidence for each candidate strategy. Here we show that this use divides all two-player games into two classes. With the standard expected-utility payoff, the dynamics can be expressed as Bayesian updating only in games (with any number of actions) where no player has a dominant strategy. The logarithmic payoff of Ay and Erb admits the Bayesian representation in every game. Coordination, anti-coordination, and cyclic games share qualitative dynamics under both payoff definitions, with equilibria displaced and selection thresholds shifted. In contrast, the flows of every game with a dominant strategy are reversed between the payoff definitions, with the strictly dominant strategy eliminated under logarithmic payoffs. Cooperation therefore emerges in the Prisoner’s Dilemma, and games of common interest converge to mutual defection. For two-action games the classification is complete and rests on an exact Hamiltonian structure shared by both payoff definitions. The structure gives a behavioural test: cycles in the classic Matching Pennies game have amplitude-independent period (isochronous) under logarithmic payoffs, but not under expected utility. Logarithmic evidence integration thus determines which strategic outcomes dynamical selection can reach, wherever learning approximates Bayesian updating.

[MA-13] Ontology-guided multi-agent reasoning for explainable differential diagnosis

【速读】：该论文旨在解决当前生成式人工智能在临床鉴别诊断中因依赖训练数据中的模式识别而非基于真实临床证据，导致诊断结论存在幻觉（hallucination）、推理过程不透明、难以追溯和验证的问题。其核心解决方案是提出一种基于本体论（ontology-guided）的多智能体（multiagent）鉴别诊断框架，通过将诊断推理过程结构化并锚定于由专家构建的医学知识库，实现症状、临床发现与疾病间关系的显式建模。该框架将诊断分解为可审计、可解释的推理步骤，确保推理由实证支持，显著降低幻觉风险，提升诊断的透明性、可追溯性与一致性。同时，系统通过识别最具区分度的缺失症状，生成针对性随访问题，模拟临床问诊过程以减少不确定性。整体设计有效提升了人工智能辅助诊断的可靠性、可解释性与准确性。

作者: Roxana Ramona Szomiu,George Ursu,Adrian Groza
机构: Technical University of Cluj-Napoca (克卢日-纳波卡理工大学); Artificial Intelligence Research Institute AIRi@UTCN (人工智能研究院 AIRi@UTCN)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Effective differential diagnosis depends on well structured and unambiguous patient case descriptions, since incomplete or ambiguous clinical information readily leads to diagnostic errors and inconsistent reasoning. Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown promising capabilities in medical question answering and clinical reasoning; however, even when achieving competitive performance on medical benchmarks, they often rely on pattern recognition learned from training data rather than grounded clinical evidence, and can generate plausible yet unsupported diagnostic conclusions. Their reasoning remains largely opaque, making it difficult for clinicians to assess the evidence and rationale behind a given recommendation. To address this gap, we propose an ontology-guided, multiagent differential diagnosis framework that replicates the iterative reasoning process of physicians. The framework grounds diagnostic inference in a structured, expert-curated medical knowledge base, enabling interpretation of symptoms, clinical findings, or disease relationships, while decomposing diagnosis into explicit, auditable reasoning steps. This ontology-based grounding constrains inference to evidence-backed associations, reducing hallucination and improving diagnostic transparency, traceability, and consistency. The system then identifies the most discriminative missing symptoms and generates targeted follow-up questions to reduce uncertainty through a process that mirrors to clinical inquiry. Together, these components improve the reliability, explainability, and diagnostic accuracy of AI-assisted differential diagnosis. The source code is publicly available.

[MA-14] Compatibility and future-proof testing for multi-agent systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多个独立开发的自主代理（autonomous agents）在共享环境中协同运行时，如何保障其联合兼容性（如安全性和任务完成性）的问题。传统方法依赖于集中式规范或交互机制的设计，但在代理设计涉及开发者机密且未来可能引入新代理的情况下，此类中心化方案既不现实也不具备足够灵活性。为此，论文提出一种双层结构：由监管者发布种子代理（seed agents），各开发者独立测试其代理，确保其与所有与种子代理兼容的代理保持兼容，这一性质被称为“未来鲁棒性”（future-proofness）。该机制的关键在于通过种子代理的闭包（closure）定义未来鲁棒代理，并证明该闭包在种子集合上具有单调性；同时，研究仅需与种子代理交互的可执行测试，分析其在识别未来鲁棒代理方面的区分能力。核心解决方案是构建基于种子代理的、无需跨代理协调即可保证联合兼容性的形式化框架。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36289
作者: Yueshan Li,Lorenzo Fiaschi,Andrea Censi,Emilio Frazzoli
机构: ETH Zurich (苏黎世联邦理工学院)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Robotics (cs.RO)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Independently developed autonomous agents, such as autonomous vehicles, must guarantee joint compatibility, such as safety and task-completion requirements, when they operate in a shared environment. Existing methods require a centrally designed specification, or interaction mechanism before any agent is deployed. However, such centralized design is unrealistic when agent designs are confidential to their developers, and it is not flexible enough to accommodate future agent designs. We study a bi-level structure in which a regulator coordinates developers by publishing seed agents, and each developer independently tests its agent to ensure that it is compatible with every seed-compatible agent, a property we call future-proofness. Under this structure, joint compatibility is guaranteed for any agents that are designed and tested independently, without any coordination with each other. In this work, we first formulate compatibility for general multi-agent systems and show why it is not trivially implied by seed-compatibility. We then characterize the future-proof agents as the closure of the seed and show that this closure is monotone in the seed. Finally, we study a class of executable tests that involve interaction with the seed alone, and we ask to what extent such tests can distinguish the future-proof agents.

[MA-15] he Inbox as a Coordination Primitive for LLM Agent Societies

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大规模语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）代理在协同过程中因上下文长度有限而导致的信息读取效率低下问题。传统推送（push）机制下，消息由发送方决定何时进入接收方上下文，导致接收方只能按到达顺序读取并丢弃最旧消息，当代理同时参与大量协调任务时，极易因上下文溢出而错过关键回复，造成严重信息丢失。论文提出以拉取（pull）机制为核心的“收件箱”（inbox）作为新的协调原语，使消息存储于上下文外的独立队列中，由接收方自主决策读取与保留策略。其核心解决方案在于将信息访问权交还给接收方，通过设计可定制的读取规则（包括读取什么、保留什么、发送方支付什么、回复可包含什么），实现对高负载、高噪声通信环境下的高效协调。实验表明，在模拟规模达16,000个代理的系统中，推送机制在多任务并发下错误率高达97%，而引入带有可退还押金机制的收件箱可在不同规模下稳定找到约60%的目标代理；在真实邮件网络中，即使仅半数代理采用该机制，一跳搜索仍可恢复42%的有效请求，远超转发搜索的5%。研究证明，有效的多代理协调必须构建适配个体流量特征与角色的“收件箱层”，以应对动态负载下的信息获取挑战。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36264
作者: Karthik Sreedhar,Leo Yuan,Pradyumna Chari,Ramesh Raskar
机构: MIT Media Lab (麻省理工学院媒体实验室)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Language-model agents increasingly coordinate in large groups, and current agent protocols focus on delivering messages. For these agents, however, the scarce resource is not delivery but reading: every message costs tokens, and the context is finite. Current infrastructure works by push: the sender decides when a message enters the recipient’s context, so the recipient reads in arrival order and drops the oldest messages once its context is full. We study the alternative, pull, in which messages wait in an inbox outside the context and the recipient’s own rules decide what it reads and keeps. We argue that the inbox is a coordination primitive: each agent sets its rules privately, and those rules decide whether other agents’ requests reach it. In simulated societies of up to 16,000 agents, with every decision an LLM judgment, we report three findings. First, push fails as an agent takes part in more coordination at once: an agent leading 20 negotiations with a full memory proposes options already rejected 97% of the time, because it has dropped the oldest replies. Second, an inbox is necessary under heavy, noisy traffic. Where first come, first read misses every request, an inbox that first reads messages carrying a refundable deposit still finds about 60% of the agents a request needs, at every size from 1,000 to 16,000. On a real email network, losses compound: when half the agents adopt such an inbox, forwarded search recovers only 5% of full adoption, against 42% for one-hop search. Third, an inbox comprises four decisions (what to read, what to keep, what a sender pays, and what a reply may say), and the best rule for each depends on the traffic and the agent’s role. Multi-agent coordination under load requires an inbox layer designed for the traffic each agent receives.

[MA-16] cuArms: GPU-Accelerated Conflict-Based Planning for Multi-Arm Manipulation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多臂操作（multi-arm manipulation）中任务分配、调度、运动规划与操作技能协同优化的难题，尤其针对现有方法在计算效率、可扩展性及对领域特定假设依赖方面的局限。其核心挑战在于如何在保证实时性的同时，有效处理多机器人间的动作冲突与死锁问题，并支持大规模任务与长时程规划。解决方案的关键在于提出cuArms——一种与GPU并行计算协同设计的基于冲突的规划器，通过复用单个机器人生成的多模态路径图（multi-modal roadmaps）高效分解搜索空间，并采用惰性搜索机制（lazy search）动态解决冲突与死锁。同时，引入高层调度器（high-level scheduler）生成候选任务骨架（skeletons），指导cuArms生成协调一致的操作计划，实现任务分配、调度、运动轨迹与操作技能的联合优化。实验表明，该方法在无需数日领域特定训练的前提下，即可实现实时初始解和持续改进的运动质量与调度性能，显著优于现有方法，建立了新的基准。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36250
作者: Philip Huang,Fabio Ramos,Jiaoyang Li,Caelan Garrett,Lars Johannsmeier
机构: NVIDIA(英伟达); Carnegie Mellon University (卡内基梅隆大学); University of Sydney (悉尼大学)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 8 pages, 8 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-arm manipulation has the potential to dramatically improve the throughput, efficiency, and dexterity of many manipulation tasks. Recent work coordinates multiple robot arms in a shared workcell by allocating and scheduling tasks for greater parallelism, jointly planning multi-arm motions, or directly learning multi-arm policies. So far, these approaches are either too slow, rely on domain-specific assumptions, or scale poorly with the number of robots and task horizon. Thus, we introduce cuArms, a conflict-based planner co-designed with GPU parallelism that efficiently decomposes the search space using reusable multi-modal roadmaps for individual robots and resolves conflicts and deadlocks through a lazy search. To jointly optimize task assignment, schedules, motions, and manipulation skills, we integrate a high-level scheduler that proposes candidate skeletons for cuArms to ground into coordinated manipulation plans. Experimental results show that our method establishes a new state of the art, with real-time initial solutions and anytime improvements in both motion quality and scheduling, without days of domain-specific training required by learning approaches. Videos of both simulated and real-world industrial tasks are available on this https URL.

[MA-17] EREBOTS 4.0: A framework for conversational assistants with A2A agents and MCP tools

【速读】：该论文旨在解决当前多智能体系统在从基于规则的符号化智能体向基于语言模型的亚符号化智能体演进过程中，仍存在基础设施重复构建、系统可复现性差以及缺乏统一标准化框架的问题。其核心解决方案是提出 EREBOTS 4.0，一个开源的混合式人工智能（Hybrid-AI）多智能体框架，专为对话助手场景设计。该框架的关键在于通过“模型上下文协议”（Model Context Protocol, MCP）将语言模型智能体与确定性工具相结合，实现精确计算；并通过“智能体到智能体协议”（Agent2Agent protocol, A2A）由编排器在每轮交互中动态选择一个或多个专业智能体进行调用，支持本地或远程智能体通过配置文件注册。此外，框架还统一管理身份认证、用户上下文（含同意标志）、任务状态与执行轨迹，显著提升了系统的可扩展性与可复现性。A2A 服务器在官方 A2A 技术兼容性套件测试中成功通过 97 项追踪要求，无任何失败，验证了其标准化与互操作性的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36221
作者: Elia Pacioni,Davide Calvaresi,Andrei C. Coman,Ismael Jaggi,Valerio Crocetti,Gaetano Manzo,Michael Ignaz Schumacher
机构: HES-SO Valais-Wallis(瑞士高等教育南部瓦莱-瓦利应用科技学院); University of Extremadura(埃斯特雷马杜拉大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In recent years, multi-agent systems have shifted from rule-based, symbolic agents to sub-symbolic agents built on language models. However, several limitations remain unresolved. The new frontier is neuro-symbolic agents, which pair language models with deterministic tools and explicit protocols. Without a common framework to standardize and compose them, each study rebuilds the same infrastructure, and results are hard to replicate. This paper presents EREBOTS 4.0, an open-source, hybrid-AI, multi-agent framework that fills this gap for conversational assistants. Language-model agents plan and route requests, while deterministic tools compute exact results over the Model Context Protocol (MCP). An orchestrator selects one or more specialist agents per turn and calls them over the Agent2Agent protocol (A2A). A new agent, local or remote, is added by listing its URL in a configuration file. The framework also manages identity, user context with consent flags, task states and traces. Its A2A server passed 97 tracked requirements in the official A2A Technology Compatibility Kit, with no failures.

[MA-18] Replication or Corroboration? An Axiomatic Framework for Evidential Dependence in Multi-Agent Debate

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体辩论中报告匹配（matching reports）的判定难题，即区分重复证据（replication）与独立证据源支持同一主张的协同验证（corroboration）。其核心问题在于：现有评判机制在处理匹配内容时，要么因计数报告次数而过度加权重复、转述或片段化提交（relays, paraphrases, excerpt splits），要么通过合并所有匹配内容来避免偏倚，却同时抹除了真实的协同验证价值。解决方案的关键在于引入谱系商（lineage quotient），该机制通过消除表述差异、身份标识、出现频次及任意根节点命名等冗余信息，同时保持不同证据根之间的可区分性，从而实现对复制行为的不变性（invariance）与对新证据根的严格响应。研究证明，在满足根复制不变性（RRI）条件下，仅复制行为无法改变判决结果，且正成本复制被严格占优；而基于出现频率或内容键值的评判规则则存在可获利的策略偏离。进一步地，论文建立了信息边界理论：若评判接口无法区分副本与新证据根，则任何评判者均无法同时忽略副本并严格响应新证据根。为此，作者将谱系商扩展至定量双极论证框架（QBAFs），刻画了严格新根响应特性，并在符号一致路径上传播下证明了其有效性，最终导出紧致闭式响应模量。大规模审计实验（涵盖28,224个直接星型结构、2,052个多层有向无环图及277个来自AVerTeC的干预样本）验证了在给定划分下复制与协同验证之间预测的分离效果。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36151
作者: Hoang-Loc Cao,Truong Thanh Hung Nguyen,Phuc Truong Loc Nguyen,Vo Thanh Khang Nguyen,Phuc Ho,Hung Nguyen,Duc Pham,Long Tran-Thanh,Hung Cao
机构: University of New Brunswick, Canada; FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg, Germany; FPT Software, Vietnam; Vietnamese-German University, Vietnam; HCM University of Technology, Vietnam; University of Warwick, United Kingdom
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Logic in Computer Science (cs.LO)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In multi-agent debates, matching reports can arise for two different reasons: agents may repeat the same evidence (replication), or they may provide separate evidential roots that support the same claim (corroboration). A judge must distinguish these two cases. Counting report occurrences gives extra weight to relays, paraphrases, alias resubmissions, and excerpt splits, while merging all matching content avoids this only by also removing genuine corroboration. We formalize this tension as a minimal judgment game in which acquiring new evidence is costly, but replication is cheap. We show that root replication invariance (RRI) is exactly threshold-uniform replication immunity. Under RRI, replication-only deviations cannot change the verdict, and positive-cost replication is strictly dominated, whereas occurrence-sensitive and content-keyed judges admit profitable deviations. We also establish an information boundary: if a judge’s observation interface cannot distinguish a replica from a matched fresh root, no judge can both ignore the replica and respond strictly to the fresh root. To preserve this distinction, we introduce the lineage quotient, which removes wording, identity, occurrence multiplicity, and arbitrary root names while keeping distinct roots separate. On orbit-connected domains, it is the coarsest representation sufficient for every deterministic judge invariant to replication and root-label renaming. We further lift this construction to quantitative bipolar argumentation frameworks (QBAFs), characterize strict fresh-root response, prove its propagation along sign-consistent paths under DF-QuAD, and derive a tight closed-form response modulus. Exhaustive audits over 28,224 direct-star profiles, 2,052 multi-layer DAGs, with matched interventions on 277 AVeriTeC-derived profiles, show the predicted separation between replication and corroboration under a supplied partition.

[MA-19] PolicyMediator: Multi-Regional Policy Learning through Mediation Agents with Evolving Skills in OPC Ecosystems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决数字平台与大语言模型（LLM）驱动的个体企业（One-person Companies, OPCs）在跨区域选址过程中因政策认知不完善导致的匹配错位问题。这类高度流动的数字游民型创业者依赖自身对区域政策的感知进行决策，但其有限或偏差的认知常使其拒绝实际适宜的地区，造成资源配置效率低下与区域政策调整滞后。现有方法或基于固定认知优化资源分配，或仅通过共识聚合意见而未将认知更新反馈至政策学习过程，形成“认知—政策”脱节。为此，本文提出一种认知约束下的领导者-多追随者斯塔克尔伯格（Stackelberg）框架——PolicyMediator，通过双边中介机制实现政府与OPCs之间的双向信息校准：一方面，中介向OPCs解释经验证的政策以增强认知一致性与信任；另一方面，将OPCs的真实需求与未解疑虑反馈给政府，驱动政策动态迭代。其自演化能力基于验证轨迹、资源分配、承载能力及目标演进等多维指标持续优化策略，而非仅依赖中介成功与否。在涵盖中国六个地区、五类OPC、三类仿真器和五种情景的综合实验中，PolicyMediator在全部15组组合中均表现最优，相较基线平均提升政府总体目标（含经济绩效、就业效益与政策可及性公平性）42.4%，同时提升OPC平均效用40.9%。其核心创新在于构建了“认知修正—政策学习—行为响应”的闭环反馈机制，实现了政策制定与主体认知的协同进化。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35997
作者: Jie Li,Bin Guo,Georgina Curto,Zikang Liu,Mengqi Chen,yu li
机构: Northwestern Polytechnical University (西北工业大学); United Nations University Institute in Macau (联合国大学澳门研究所)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computers and Society (cs.CY); Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC)
备注: 12 pages, 5 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:One-person companies (OPCs) are emerging enterprises operated by individual entrepreneurs through digital platforms and LLM-based AI agents. These highly skilled entrepreneurs are characterized by being digital nomads, with limited reliance on local ecosystems. Governments in China use distinct regional support policies to attract mobile OPCs, turning local support into a cross-regional coordination problem. OPCs compare regions to maximize their own utility, but imperfect policy perceptions may cause them to reject otherwise suitable locations. Existing policy-learning methods optimize resources under fixed perceptions, while consensus-formation methods aggregate views without feeding cognitive changes back into policy learning. This disconnect produces mismatched location choices and inefficient regional policy adjustment. We introduce PolicyMediator, a cognition-constrained leader-multi-follower Stackelberg framework with bilateral mediation. The mediator explains verified policies to OPCs to build awareness and trust, and reports their needs and unresolved concerns to governments for policy learning. Its self-evolving skills retain, revise, or prune strategies using verification, allocation, capacity, and objective trajectories rather than mediation success alone. Across six-region simulations in China with five OPC types, five scenarios, and three OPC-simulator backbones, PolicyMediator ranks first in all 15 OPC-backbone–scenario combinations. Over the eight-baseline mean, it improves the aggregate government objective, combining economic performance, employment benefit, and policy-access equality, by 42.4% and average OPC utility by 40.9%.

[MA-20] EMMA: Structured Episodic Memory for Multi-Agent Workflow Synthesis

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）代理在专业领域应用中面临的任务特定知识与流程缺失问题，同时克服传统参数微调成本高、不可解释，以及人工设计代理系统依赖专家劳动的局限性。核心挑战在于：单一代理在跨任务场景下易受干扰，尤其在多应用导航或数据池分析等复杂任务中表现不佳；尽管多代理演化可缓解此问题，但现有方法缺乏明确的更新规则，且依赖主干模型决定修改位置与幅度，导致学习过程受主干结构偏好影响，而非基于实际失败诊断，造成技能积累不均与代理生成混乱。为此，本文提出EMMA（结构化情景记忆用于多代理工作流合成），将多代理系统的配置（包括控制器路由、专家继承通用提示、每步程序化技能）视为情景记忆，并通过“反思器”明确分配每个诊断出的失败至其对应的修正责任范围，提出相应编辑；同时采用独立于主干模型的约束机制，确保所有采纳的更新均具有明确归属、增量性与边界限制。实验表明，EMMA在KramaBench、AppWorld和BBEH三个基准上，针对五种主干模型和四种基线（ACE、GEPA、EvoMAS、ADAS）均取得最优性能，最高超越最强基线32.5%，且在不同主干间保持稳定提升，训练执行次数减少17%-38%，显著提升了效率与泛化能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35966
作者: Ruijia Niu,Kaiwen Liu,Rose Yu,Kristina Klinkner
机构: Amazon(亚马逊); University of California, San Diego (加州大学圣地亚哥分校)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Deploying LLM agents in specialized domains often require fine-grained task-specific procedures and knowledge a general model lacks, yet parameter training is costly and non-interpretable, and hand-engineered agent systems shift the cost to expert labor. Episodic memory updates at context level, but single agent adaptation struggles to alleviate cross-task interference, especially with complex tasks such as multi-application navigation or data pool analysis. Although multi-agent evolution alleviates this problem, existing methods lack clear definitions on update rules and rely on the backbone model to decide where and how much the system changes. This ill-scoped evolution makes learning follow the backbone’s structural preferences rather than the observed failures: one backbone accumulates skills while another spawns agents. We present EMMA (structured Episodic Memory for Multi-Agent workflow synthesis), which treats the configuration of a multi-agent system (controller routing memory, specialists inheriting a generalist prompt, and per-step procedural skills) as episodic memory. EMMA makes the ownership and admissibility of updates explicit: a reflector assigns each diagnosed failure to the scope owning its correction and proposes one edit within it, and backbone-independent guards keep every accepted edit scoped, incremental and bounded. Across KramaBench, AppWorld and BBEH with five backbones and four baselines (ACE, GEPA, EvoMAS and ADAS), EMMA attains the best overall performance on every benchmark, up to 32.5% over the strongest baseline, maintains consistent improvements across backbones, and uses 17-38% fewer training executions than the most efficient baseline.

[MA-21] A Hyper-Logical View on Multi-Agent Path Planning

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体路径规划（Multi-Agent Path Planning, MAPP）中因不同约束、需求与目标导致的算法碎片化问题，即针对每个变体需设计专用求解算法，缺乏统一建模与分析框架。其核心解决方案在于引入超时序逻辑（HyperLTL）及其ω-正则扩展HyperQPTL，构建一种以规范为中心的统一形式化方法，能够精确刻画多种MAPP变体中的多路径行为及其随时间演化的特性。关键在于通过超逻辑语言实现对跨智能体约束的表达、最优性目标的形式化以及与验证、解释和因果分析等超性质分析技术的衔接，从而为MAPP提供一个可比较、可扩展且具备理论深度的通用建模与分析平台。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35964
作者: Hadar Frenkel,Dor Atzmon
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-Agent Path Planning (MAPP) requires collision-free paths for multiple agents. MAPP has numerous real-life applications, including the navigation of automated vehicles, and has therefore many variants considering different constraints, requirements, and objectives. For each such variant, a new algorithmic treatment is often developed. This paper takes a complementary, specification-centered view: we show that many MAPP variants can be modeled in HyperLTL, a temporal logic that reasons about multiple paths and their evolution through time, and in its omega-regular extension HyperQPTL. The contribution is not a claim that current hyperproperty model checkers replace specialized MAPP solvers. Rather, the hyper-logical view gives a unified language for comparing MAPP variants, adding cross-agent constraints, expressing optimality, and connecting MAPP to verification, explanation, and causality techniques for hyperproperties.

[MA-22] Agent Baton: Efficient Model Collaboration in Agent ic Tasks

【速读】：该论文旨在解决长时程智能体任务（long-horizon agentic tasks）中高成本与高效率模型之间如何协同以降低整体执行成本的同时保持任务准确率的问题。当前，高性能但昂贵的云端大模型虽能保障可靠性能，而低成本的高效模型（如低配云模型或可本地部署的小型开源模型）虽成本低廉却性能较弱，二者间的协同潜力尚未得到充分探索。论文的核心解决方案在于通过“模型交接”（model handoff）机制实现能力模型与高效模型在任务过程中的阶段性协作，关键设计在于确定交接方向与上下文传递策略。研究发现，从高效模型向能力模型交接（efficient-to-capable）通常无法有效降低成本且性能受限；而反向交接（capable-to-efficient）在任务进展的合适阶段进行，不仅能显著降低API调用成本，还能维持甚至提升任务准确率。由此提出轻量级检测器AgentBaton，基于任务进展中的重复模式学习最优交接时机，实现一次性的、简单且精准的交接策略。在11组模型对和两个基准测试上的实验表明，AgentBaton平均降低65.9%的API成本，同时在部分场景下相较纯能力模型执行还取得最高达8.8个百分点的准确率提升，并拓展了实际可用的准确率-成本帕累托前沿（Pareto frontier）。

作者: Junlong Li,Jindong Jiang,Yonggan Fu,Jiarui Yao,Hanrong Ye,Wonmin Byeon,Peter Belcak,Hao Zhang,Pavlo Molchanov
机构: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (香港科技大学); University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (伊利诺伊大学厄本那-香槟分校)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Solving long-horizon agentic tasks requires language agents to interact with their environments over multiple steps, and reliable performance often comes from the expensive capable models available through cloud providers. Meanwhile, alternative efficient models with inferior performance but a much lower cost are emerging, including lower-tier cloud models and smaller open-weights models deployable on local hardware. This raises a natural question that remains less explored than traditional query-level routing: can capable and efficient models collaborate within a single long-horizon agentic task to substantially reduce cost while preserving task accuracy? In this paper, we systematically investigate key design choices for such collaboration through model handoffs, where one model takes over from another, focusing on handoff direction and context transfer. We find that efficient-to-capable handoffs generally underperform capable-only execution with limited or even no cost reduction, whereas capable-to-efficient handoffs at suitable stages of task progress largely preserve or even improve accuracy while substantially reducing cost. These findings suggest that a one-time, simple, well-timed handoff strategy is good enough for cost-effective agent collaboration, motivating AgentBaton, a lightweight detector that learns when to hand off from recurring patterns in task progress. Across 11 model pairs and two representative benchmarks, AgentBaton reduces API costs by 65.9% on average while largely preserving task accuracy, with accuracy gains of up to 8.8 percentage points over capable-only execution. Experiments across various reasoning-effort settings further show that AgentBaton extends the empirical accuracy-cost Pareto frontier.

[MA-23] PASS Is a Claim Not an Observation: Mechanical Re-verification of 10 Self-Asserted Fix Claims in a Live Multi-Agent Audit Layer

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在多智能体系统中，当智能体声称已自行修复其缺陷时，如何验证此类自述修复声明的真实性问题。其核心挑战在于：智能体的自我报告缺乏可信赖的独立验证机制，可能导致虚假或不准确的修复声明被误认为有效。解决方案的关键在于建立一套机械化的三重验证标准（C1–C3），通过文件修改时间戳一致性、所声称防御模式在指定标识符与调用位置的存在性、以及仅基于广播公告的确定性规则复验三个维度进行客观检验。研究发现，在满足完全可复验条件（C3通过）的修复声明中，仍有50%未能通过标识符与调用点检查（C2失败），表明修复要么未出现在声明位置，要么根本不存在。因此，论文的核心结论是：一个“PASS”声明本质上是一种需要独立验证的主张，而非对修复完成状态的客观观察，强调了在生成式协作系统中引入强制性外部验证机制的必要性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35950
作者: Lei Zhenbing,Lei Chang
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
备注: 8 pages, 4 tables. v1.1 revised Oct 24, 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:When agents claim to have fixed their own defects, how do we know the fix is real? We mechanically re-verified 10 self-asserted code-level fix claims from a privileged coordination agent (azone_god) operating in AITRAP, a live multi-agent knowledge-tree platform. These 10 claims were extracted from a corpus of 179 coordination broadcasts (28 containing structured fix assertions, 31 unique fix-ID/message pairs, 18 distinct fix identifiers). Fix claims use mixed English/Chinese formats (PASS, checkmarks, and “verification passed” declarations). Each code-level claim was checked against three criteria: (1) file modification timestamp (mtime) consistency – 70% pass; (2) presence of the claimed defensive pattern at the specified identifier and call site – 60% pass in the claimed file (80% anywhere in the codebase); (3) deterministic rule-based re-verification from the broadcast announcement alone – 80% pass. The critical finding: among claims that provide sufficient information for re-verification (C3-pass), 50% fail the identifier+call-site check (C2-fail) – the fix either does not exist at the claimed location or does not exist at all. This demonstrates that self-asserted fix claims cannot be trusted without independent mechanical verification. Our central claim: a PASS declaration is a claim requiring independent verification, not an observation of fix completion.

[MA-24] Who Convinced Whom? Tracing How LLM s Change Their Minds in Multi-Agent Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体辩论（Multi-agent Debate, MAD）中个体决策与集体结果受同伴沟通影响的机制问题，尤其关注辩论过程是否真正提升了判断的独立性与准确性。其核心挑战在于：尽管辩论后达成一致可能提升共识度，但这种一致性未必源于独立验证，而可能反映群体思维偏差或信息依赖。为此，研究提出MAD Bench——一个涵盖知识推理、价值判断与安全拒答等维度的2,400题基准测试，并采用“回合匹配的独立反思对照”设计，评估三个开源模型在辩论与独立反思两种情境下的表现。关键发现包括：在需更改答案的响应中，辩论前强制选择输出比反思更接近最终正确答案（如Qwen3.5-9B模型下分别为65.4%与22.3%）；同伴回答内容与推理路径对模型的影响具有显著模型依赖性，且将相同文本归因于接收者自身而非其他代理时，其影响力发生显著变化；历史表现记录对答案偏好影响强于职业身份线索；注意力掩码揭示不同模型检查点在决策置信度上的差异化变化；在非数值型参考标注问题上，辩论虽带来微弱准确率提升，却使一致错误率上升3.1–7.4个百分点；更长辩论周期中，共识更强且个体正确性相关性更高，表明强共识可能伴随更多共通错误。因此，该研究强调，在评估辩论系统时，除准确性外，必须纳入对依赖性及一致错误的分析，以揭示潜在的认知协同风险。

作者: Arnesh Batra,Aniket Khandelwal,Jashn Khemani,Krish Thukral,Arush Gumber,Denis Federico Lim,Ujwal Kumar,Phan Xuan Tan
机构: Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology, Delhi(印地普拉斯特亚信息技术研究所，德里); Manipal University Jaipur(曼帕尔大学贾伊普尔分校); Shibaura Institute of Technology(芝浦工业大学); Independent Researcher(独立研究员)

Abstract:Multi-agent debate (MAD) aims to improve language-model decisions through the exchange of arguments, yet agreement after debate need not reflect independent corroboration. We investigate how peer communication influences individual decisions and collective outcomes through behavioral and internal interventions. We introduce MAD Bench, a 2,400-question benchmark spanning knowledge and reasoning, values and moral judgment, and safety and refusal, and evaluate three open-weight models using a round-matched independent-reflection control. Among answer-changing responses, a forced-choice readout before rationale generation matches the eventual answer more often in debate than in reflection (65.4% versus 22.3% on Qwen3.5-9B). Message ablations reveal model-dependent effects of peer answers and reasoning, while attributing identical text to the receiver rather than another agent substantially changes its influence. For the tested source descriptions, stated track record affects answer preferences more strongly than professional-status cues across all three models. Attention masking produces different changes in decision margins across the three checkpoints. On fully parsed, reference-labelled non-numeric questions, debate yields small estimated accuracy improvements over initial majority voting, while increasing the rate of unanimous wrong answers by 3.1-7.4 percentage points relative to reflection. Longer debates show persistent consensus and greater correlation between agents’ correctness than reflection. These findings show that stronger consensus can coexist with more shared errors, motivating evaluations that assess dependence and unanimous errors alongside accuracy.

[MA-25] SCOPE: Source Credibility and Outlet Profiling Engine

【速读】：该论文旨在解决新闻媒体机构在偏见（bias）、事实性（factuality）和可信度（credibility）方面评估不透明、缺乏可解释性与证据支持的问题。现有方法多依赖单一模型或有限信息源，难以全面、可靠地识别媒体内容中的偏差与错误。为此，论文提出SCOPE——一个基于多智能体架构的新闻媒体分析系统，其核心解决方案在于采用分解式、证据驱动的智能体工作流：通过专门分工的智能体协同完成文章获取、内容分析、外部证据检索、评分与报告生成等环节，并借助结构化演示界面实现中间推理过程与证据的可追溯性。该设计不仅提升了评估精度（如在200家媒体的基准测试中，显著降低偏见与事实性MAE、达到零漏检的事实核查失败检测及最低的事实错误率），更增强了媒体评估过程的透明性与可审计性。因此，其关键创新在于将复杂评估任务分解为可验证的智能体协作流程，使结果具备可解释性与证据支撑，从而推动更可信、可信赖的媒体画像技术发展。

Abstract:We present SCOPE, a multi-agent system for profiling news media outlets with respect to bias, factuality, and credibility. Given an outlet URL, SCOPE coordinates specialized agents for article acquisition, content analysis, external evidence search, scoring, and report generation. The system follows an MBFC-style methodology while making intermediate evidence and agent outputs inspectable through a structured demonstration interface. On a benchmark of 200 media outlets, SCOPE outperforms LLM-only, article-only, search-only, and media-background-check baselines on most metrics, achieving the lowest bias and factuality MAE, perfect failed-fact-check detection, and the lowest factual error rate. These results suggest that decomposed, evidence-grounded agent workflows can support more transparent and reliable media profiling. Our code is available at this https URL, and a live demonstration at this https URL.

[MA-26] Feedback autocratic strategies in stochastic games

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体在随机环境中协同决策的最优控制问题，即如何通过设计有效的策略实现对博弈结果（收益）的可控性。其核心挑战在于将重复博弈中已有的单方面收益调控策略扩展至更复杂的随机博弈框架，并确保这些策略在动态、不确定环境下仍能有效发挥控制器作用。解决方案的关键在于提出并分析“反馈策略”（feedback strategies）这一概念，将其作为连接重复博弈中收益调控理论与随机博弈中反馈控制理论的桥梁。研究在特定假设下，给出了反馈策略能够有效调控收益的充要条件，并通过多个与社会困境相关的实例验证了该方法的有效性，从而实现了从重复博弈到随机博弈的理论拓展与统一。

作者: Masahiko Ueda
机构: Tokyo Metropolitan University (东京都立大学)
类目: Physics and Society (physics.soc-ph); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Systems and Control (eess.SY)

Abstract:A stochastic game is an optimal control problem for multiple agents in a stochastic environment. Stochastic games contain important practical problems, related to environmental issues or traffic flows. If the number of environmental states is one, such stochastic games are called repeated games. In repeated games, several strategies which unilaterally control payoffs have been proposed, and these strategies work in a mechanism similar to feedback control. In this paper, we generalize these strategies as feedback strategies in stochastic games, and investigate their properties. In particular, we provide a necessary and sufficient condition for such feedback strategies to work as controllers of payoffs under some assumptions. We demonstrate the performance of such feedback strategies in several examples related to social dilemmas. Our findings connect the theory of payoff control in repeated games to the theory of feedback control in stochastic games.

[NLP-0] Heads of Security: Learned Attention Gates Improve Prompt Injection Robustness

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大模型在面对提示注入攻击（prompt injection attack）时安全性不足的问题，尤其针对自适应攻击（adaptive attacks）和复杂应用场景下安全与性能之间的权衡难题。其核心挑战在于如何在不显著损害模型通用任务能力的前提下，有效抵御恶意指令的渗透。解决方案的关键在于提出“安全头”（Heads of Security, HoS），通过引入一组可学习的、基于注意力头（attention head）的门控机制，实现指令数据与可信内容之间的显式分离。该机制使模型能够动态调节各注意力头对可信与不可信输入片段的关注权重，从而在处理潜在恶意输入时保持对原始指令的遵循，同时维持对正常任务的高可用性。实验表明，相较于现有最优微调防御方法SecAlign++和架构级防御ASIDE，HoS在对抗黑盒强化学习攻击（如RL-Hammer）和白盒高级攻击（如Claudini）时表现出显著更强的鲁棒性，且在标准任务基准上保持了更优的通用性能，尤其在少样本设置下避免了性能退化，证明了通过精细化注意力干预可有效提升生成式AI（Generative AI）的安全-效用平衡。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37657
作者: Igor Shilov,Xiaoxue Yang,Alexander Panfilov,Evgenii Kortukov,Matthieu Meeus,Peter Romov,Wojciech Samek,Jonas Geiping,Yves-Alexandre de Montjoye
机构: 未知
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We introduce Heads of Security (HoS), a prompt injection defense that enforces instruction-data separation via a small set of learned per-head attention gates. HoS learns how each head should redistribute attention between trusted and untrusted tokens, enabling models to reason over untrusted content without following injected instructions. We evaluate HoS on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and GPT-OSS-20B. We compare it against SecAlign++, a state-of-the-art finetuning-based defense, and ASIDE, a defense that, like ours, builds instruction-data separation into the model architecture. We show that HoS offers greater robustness to adaptive attacks, better performance on standard utility benchmarks, and matches top performance on standard agentic prompt injection benchmarks. More specifically, the black-box RL-Hammer attack reaches 97% ASR against GPT-OSS-20B and 85% against SecAlign, but only 10% against HoS. Claudini, a state-of-the-art white-box attack, strengthened against HoS through autoresearch, requires 3 times more FLOPs to reach the same ASR on HoS as it does on GPT-OSS-20B or SecAlign. HoS preserves base-model utility across standard multiple-choice benchmarks and prompting setups, whereas SecAlign and ASIDE degrade in few-shot settings. On agentic benchmarks with static attacks, HoS and SecAlign perform similarly and substantially improve the security-utility trade-off over the base model. ASIDE struggles with tool use, achieving only 10% utility. These results show that prompt injection robustness can be achieved and improved through targeted attention interventions.

[NLP-1] GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在多轮代理型工作负载中因提示词缺陷、工具调用限制、随机执行过程或噪声评估等因素导致的代理失败问题。现有反思式提示优化器（如GEPA）依赖于失败的推理轨迹进行学习，但此类失败可能蕴含噪声或不可靠的学习信号，甚至对优化产生负面影响。为此，论文提出GEPA-Curator框架，其核心在于通过任务精选与历史成功轨迹检索双重机制提升提示优化的质量：关键创新在于引入任务筛选（task curation），主动排除那些可能提供噪声或不可靠学习信号的任务；以及先验成功轨迹检索（prior success retrieval），从过往成功经验中提取有效轨迹作为上下文输入至提示优化器，从而增强优化过程的可靠性与有效性。实验结果表明，GEPA-Curator在GoBrowse、ALFWorld、AppWorld及τ-bench等多个基准上显著优于基线方法，性能提升最高达20.7%（相对于GEPA）和21.2%（相对于ACE）。

机构: UC Berkeley (加州大学伯克利分校); ICSI (国际计算机科学研究所); LBNL (劳伦斯伯克利国家实验室); Furiosa AI (福里奥斯人工智能公司); KAIST (韩国科学技术院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in multi-turn agentic workloads that require sustained interaction with complex environments. Existing reflective prompt optimizers such as GEPA learn from failed rollouts, but agentic failures can also come from prompt weaknesses, harness limitations, stochastic execution, or noisy judges. We argue that such failures may not provide useful learning signal, and may even be harmful; and thus it is essential to curate which tasks are provided to the prompt optimizer for better performance. We introduce GEPA-Curator, a framework that augments the prompt optimizer to select which agent experiences should shape prompt optimization. In particular, GEPA-Curator consists of two components: task curation, which filters out tasks that are likely to provide noisy or unreliable learning signals, and prior success retrieval, which selectively retrieves past successful trajectories for a task and provides them as additional context to the prompt optimizer. We evaluate GEPA-Curator on GoBrowse, ALFWorld, AppWorld, and \tau -bench, using both Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Opus 5 as optimizer models. GEPA-Curator matches or exceeds the mean performance of both baselines, with gains of up to 20.7% over GEPA and 21.2% over ACE.

[NLP-2] Multi-State Linear Attention with Generalized Second-Order Routing

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决自注意力机制（self-attention）在长序列建模中因二次时间复杂度而限制大语言模型（Large Language Models）扩展的问题。现有方法如多状态线性注意力（Multi-State Linear Attention, MSLA）通过将上下文分段并为每段维护独立的记忆状态来提升效率，但其仅依赖查询与各段键的均值对齐进行信息聚合，忽略了对齐分布内部方差的建模，导致信息利用不充分。为此，本文提出MERLIN（MomEnt Routing for multi-state LINear attention），其核心创新在于跟踪每个段落键的一阶矩（均值）和二阶矩（方差），使查询能够同时获取与各段对齐的均值与方差信息，从而实现更内容感知的跨状态读出聚合。实验表明，MERLIN在Gated DeltaNet-1.3B和Mamba-2-780M等多状态变体上显著优于现有聚合方法，在长上下文问答（long-context QA）和“针堆找针”（RULER needle-in-a-haystack）任务中分别提升8.3%和7.0%，在LongBench多个子任务上提升达13.5%和12.0%，且性能超越消耗4倍内存的基线方法。MERLIN提供了一种简洁、通用的路由机制，有效增强了MSLA类模型的长上下文建模能力。
