点击查看摘要

Abstract:A major challenge facing AI scientific discovery pipelines is how to determine when a generated idea is meaningfully novel. Ideally, novelty checks in these pipelines must be able to reject non-novel ideas while not rejecting too many novel ideas, and they should also be able to distinguish which parts of a proposal are non-novel, as opposed to opaquely discarding entire proposals. We design an analytical framework for evaluation of novelty checks with temporal ground truth at both the proposal- and claim-level, using four datasets of 1,060 proposals built from published papers, reviewer disputes, and generated ideas matching ones the field went on to publish. Auditing existing novelty checks with this framework, we find that checks with high rejection rates on non-novel work also tend to have high false alarms on ideas that are later realized by human researchers, and observe that checks built to evaluate proposals as a whole can point to claim-level prior art only by rejecting the whole proposal. We therefore introduce ClaimNov, a fine-grained, interpretable claim-level novelty module. ClaimNov catches 97% of disguised papers at a 1.5% false-alarm rate, and its claim-level novelty profile cuts the LLM judge’s false alarms from 11.8% to 1.5%. Because its verdict rests on claim-level evidence, ClaimNov also keeps proposals that build on established contributions, rejecting only 3% of ICLR-accepted proposals with a reviewer-disputed contribution and keeping 91 of 100 novel proposals with one spliced prior contribution, against 76 for the strongest existing check. Code and data are available at this https URL.

[NLP-74] AC-JEPA: Anchored Cross-Modal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Visual-to-Symbolic Translation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决跨模态翻译中因真实科学领域数据对存在不完美性、且大规模获取高质量配对数据成本高昂所导致的模型训练难题。现有方法中，监督微调（SFT）虽能通过词元级分类监督优化翻译性能，但对目标序列中的错误极为敏感；而现有的基于联合嵌入预测自监督学习（JEPA）框架多聚焦于模态内预测，难以有效支持跨模态语义对齐。为此，本文提出锚定式跨模态JEPA（AC-JEPA），其核心创新在于引入一种兼容SFT的插件式架构，利用配对数据在两个跨模态方向上预测被掩码的中间状态，从而建立联合嵌入空间下的跨模态结构一致性约束。该联合嵌入目标捕捉由上下文可预测的跨模态结构信息，同时保留直接的词元级监督路径以维持目标序列的精细结构。在自训练阶段，AC-JEPA可从由不完美伪标签对生成的连续潜在目标中学习，具备对局部数据误差的内在鲁棒性，且不会将伪词元强化为硬性分类监督。实验以光学化学结构识别为测试场景，结果表明：在仅使用清洁数据时，AC-JEPA相较纯SFT提升准确率至76.07%（对比67.40%）；而在相同伪标签数据下进行自训练，AC-JEPA进一步达到80.23%准确率，而纯SFT准确率则下降至63.47%。这验证了“锚定式联合嵌入预测”策略在有监督与弱监督场景下均能有效提升跨模态翻译性能，其关键优势在于融合了联合嵌入的结构感知能力与SFT的精细监督机制，实现了对噪声数据的稳健适应。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36493
作者: Chaofei Hong,Ziyang Chen,Baochen Wang,Christina Yi Jin,Qing Zhang
机构: Zhejiang Lab(浙江省实验室)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Cross-modal translation requires models to capture shared semantics across modalities while preserving the fine-grained structure required by the target modality. Yet in real-world scientific domains, paired data are often imperfect, while obtaining clean pairs at scale is costly. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) directly optimizes cross-modal translation through categorical token-level supervision, but this objective is sensitive to errors in the target sequences. JEPA offers a complementary representation-space objective, but most existing formulations focus on prediction within a modality rather than translation across modalities. We introduce Anchored Cross-Modal JEPA (AC-JEPA), an SFT-compatible plug-in that predicts masked intermediate states in both cross-modal directions using paired data. The joint-embedding objective targets cross-modal structure predictable from context, while the causal SFT path retains direct token-level supervision for the target sequence. During self-training, AC-JEPA learns from continuous latent targets derived from imperfect pseudo-labeled pairs, offering intrinsic tolerance to local data errors without promoting pseudo-tokens to hard categorical supervision. Using optical chemical structure recognition as a testbed, AC-JEPA trained on clean pairs achieves 76.07% accuracy on the Simple set of the WildMol benchmark, compared with 67.40% for SFT alone. Using the same pseudo-labeled data for both approaches, AC-JEPA-based self-training further raises accuracy to 80.23%, whereas accuracy under direct SFT drops from 67.40% to 63.47%. These results support SFT-anchored joint-embedding prediction as an effective strategy for cross-modal translation under both curated and imperfect supervision.

[NLP-75] A Heart Means Recursion: Exploring Visual Meaning and Communication in VLMs

【速读】： 该论文旨在探究视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）是否具备类人般的视觉交流能力，特别是其在跨模型视觉通信中的有效性与一致性。研究发现，即使是最简单的视觉符号（如红色心形），也能显著影响模型在看似无关任务（如编程问题中诱导递归解法）中的行为表现，但这种影响机制具有高度隐含性——模型对视觉符号的直接解释与实际行为之间存在显著偏差。这一现象揭示了模型在视觉通信中存在“生成-理解鸿沟”：尽管模型倾向于使用直观的形状基元进行表达，这些视觉线索却难以有效引导其他模型产生预期响应。在涉及抽象概念和叙事的任务中，模型虽能创造性地利用视觉元素传递意义，但部分通信方式对人类而言仍缺乏直观可理解性。因此，该研究的关键在于揭示VLMs在视觉语义生成与理解上的非人类惯例特征，表明其虽具备丰富、创造性的视觉化沟通潜力，但其视觉意义的生产与解读机制与人类认知存在根本差异，这既凸显了人机视觉通信的巨大前景，也指出了实现高效协作的核心挑战。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36449
作者: Alexa R. Tartaglini,Zhengxuan Wu,Thaddäus Wiedemer,Martin Wattenberg,Been Kim,Yuxuan Li
机构: Google DeepMind(谷歌深思维); Stanford University (斯坦福大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Do vision-language models (VLMs) share our ability to communicate visually? We share preliminary findings, starting from a surprising observation: simple visual symbols like a red heart can strongly influence model behavior on seemingly unrelated tasks, such as steering models towards recursive solutions on simple coding problems. Notably, this steering effect is largely implicit, as models’ direct interpretations and thinking traces about visual symbols diverge substantially from their observed behavior. In visual communication between models, this leads to a generation–interpretation gap: while models tend to send shape primitives that they (and humans) find intuitive, these visual cues often fail to steer other models. In further communication games involving abstract concepts and stories, models can creatively use visuals to transmit meaning to one another, although some communications remain non-intuitive to humans. These findings reveal that VLMs might be capable of rich, creative, and visually-grounded communication, but their interpretation and production of visual meaning diverges from human conventions in surprising ways. Together this work highlights both the promise and challenges of visual communication between humans and VLMs.

[NLP-76] CONCUR: Concordant Auxiliary Rewards for Multi-Task Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在使用强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）对大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）进行多任务训练时，主奖励（primary reward）与辅助奖励（auxiliary reward，如长度奖励）之间因“门控效应”（gating effect）导致的排序失真问题。具体而言，当主奖励较低时，辅助奖励被限制在主奖励的上限内，而现有的群体相对优势估计器（group-relative advantage estimators）未考虑这一约束，可能导致辅助奖励反向干扰主奖励的正确排序，甚至在主奖励达到上限时仅由辅助奖励决定响应排序，从而损害任务性能。针对此问题，本文提出CONCUR，一种新型优势估计方法：其核心在于将每个被门控的辅助奖励的标准化得分替换为满足两个条件的最接近值——即主奖励更高的响应不得获得更低的得分，且在主奖励达到上限时所有响应应获得相等得分。CONCUR-T在整个训练过程中强制执行这两条规则，而CONCUR-A则对在通过样本中排序一致性高于反向频率的辅助奖励放宽第二条规则。在来自两个模型家族的三个模型上，涵盖数学、代码生成、指令遵循和写作等多种任务的实验表明，两种变体均显著优于所有基线方法，也优于完全移除被门控辅助奖励的情况，证明了该方法在保持多任务学习有效性方面的优越性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36437
作者: Jixuan Leng,Si Si,Fei Wang,Cho-Jui Hsieh,Jiong Zhang,Hsiang-Fu Yu,Inderjit S. Dhillon
机构: CMU(卡内基梅隆大学); Google DeepMind(谷歌深度思维); Google(谷歌); UCLA(加利福尼亚大学洛杉矶分校)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:When a Large Language Model (LLM) is trained with Reinforcement Learning (RL) on multiple tasks, a task’s primary reward can gate auxiliary rewards such as a length reward: on a failing response, an auxiliary cannot exceed the primary. However, group-relative advantage estimators treat a gated auxiliary like any other component, so it can reverse the primary’s order, and at the primary’s ceiling only auxiliaries order responses. Keeping gated auxiliaries hurts some tasks, while dropping them hurts others. We propose CONCUR, an advantage estimator that replaces the standardized scores of each gated auxiliary with the closest scores that satisfy two conditions: responses with higher primary rewards cannot receive lower scores, and responses at the primary’s ceiling receive equal scores. CONCUR-T applies both conditions throughout training, and CONCUR-A lifts the second for an auxiliary that agrees with the primary’s order more often than it reverses it among passing responses. On three models from two families and across math, code, instruction following, and writing, both variants score higher on average than all baselines and than when all the gated auxiliaries are dropped.

[NLP-77] No Tokenizer Still a Gap: Cross-Lingual Fairness of Homoglyph and Invisible-Character Watermarking

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式文本水印在低资源语言中性能下降的问题，特别是针对传统生成时水印（generation-time watermarks）因分词器（tokenizer）对文本的处理方式差异而导致的跨语言不均衡问题。其核心解决方案是采用基于编辑的水印技术，如同形异义字符（homoglyph）和不可见字符（invisible-character）水印，这些方法不依赖于模型生成过程，而是通过替换字符为视觉相似但编码不同的同形字符或插入不可见字符来嵌入信号，从而绕过分词器的影响。研究发现，水印容量在不同语言间存在显著差异（3.3倍），且96%的变异由书写系统决定；在拉丁字母体系内，资源水平对容量无显著影响（ρ=+0.095, p=0.78），但在跨书写系统时，资源越低的语言通常使用同形字符较少的书写系统，导致水印容量更低。此外，常规复制粘贴操作会移除不可见字符，进一步加剧语言间的不平等——例如，英语或波斯语仅需约2个码点即可检测，而老挝语则需93个码点。这表明，尽管去除分词器可规避部分瓶颈，却并未消除不平等，反而将问题根源从分词器转向了书写系统的固有特性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36432
作者: Alexander Nemecek,Yuqiao Xu,Joseph Falkenburg,Erman Ayday
机构: Case Western Reserve University(凯斯西储大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Computers and Society (cs.CY)
备注: 19 pages

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Homoglyph and invisible-character watermarks are edit-based watermarks. Instead of changing how a model generates text, they hide a signal in the text after it is written. They swap some characters for homoglyphs, which look the same, or very similar, but have different Unicode code points, or they insert characters that do not display, all without access to the model that wrote the text. Generation-time watermarks work less well for lower-resourced languages due to how tokenizers split their text. Because they work on individual characters, these watermarks never touch a tokenizer, so we ask whether they escape this gap. Across 40 language varieties in 24 scripts, we measure capacity (the hidden bits each character can carry), how much of it survives routine handling and targeted removal, and how much text a keyed detector needs. Capacity varies 3.3-fold and script accounts for 96% of that variation. Within Latin script, resource level makes no detectable difference ( \rho=+0.095 , p=0.78 ), but across scripts capacity rises with it ( \rho=+0.54 , 95% CI [+0.14,+0.83] ), because lower-resourced languages tend to use scripts with few homoglyphs. Ordinary copy-paste, which strips invisible characters, widens the gap: a detector then needs about 2 code points of English or Persian but 93 of Lao. Removing the tokenizer does not remove the inequity, but instead only changes its source.

[NLP-78] SOMA: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Egocentric Behavior and Body-Motion Understanding

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs）在从第一人称视角视频中进行细粒度人体运动理解方面能力不足的问题。现有评估体系主要关注物体、场景和粗粒度动作识别，而对身体姿态、运动动态及时间推理等更精细的体感认知能力缺乏有效衡量标准，尤其在身体部分被遮挡、信息时空分散的第一人称视角下更为严峻。为此，作者提出SOMA基准，包含1,632个经人工验证的问题，覆盖身体构型、运动动力学与时间推理三大能力维度。实验表明，人类仅能以68.5%的准确率完成该任务，而表现最优的闭源模型Qwen3.6-27B在零样本条件下也仅达50.0%准确率，显示出显著差距。错误分析揭示了模型普遍存在对佩戴者自身身体状态误判、时间事件判断偏差以及对右手法偏好、重复动作计数不足等系统性偏见。为缩小这一差距，研究提出了一个包含对齐视频、人体运动与语言标注的训练数据集，并构建了一个联合学习多模态信号的基线模型。通过识别当前MLLMs在身体运动理解中的共性失败模式与缺失能力，SOMA旨在推动未来在人体运动感知与多模态推理方向的研究进展。

作者: Matea Tashkovska,Naël Ouerghemi,Haozhe Qi,Alexander Mathis
机构: École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL), Switzerland
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Neurons and Cognition (q-bio.NC)
备注: Code and data at: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Perceiving human body motion is critical for multimodal systems that understand and assist people. Yet current evaluations of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) largely focus on objects, scenes, and coarse actions, leaving their ability to reason about the body itself poorly assessed. This is especially challenging from the egocentric perspective, in which the body is only partially visible and motion must be inferred from occluded and temporally distributed cues. We introduce SOMA, a benchmark for fine-grained body-motion understanding from egocentric video, comprising 1,632 human-verified questions across three capability axes: body configuration, motion dynamics, and temporal reasoning. We evaluate 37 leading closed-source, open-source, and specialized egocentric MLLMs, complemented by an extensive human evaluation. We find that humans also find this task difficult from video alone (68.5% accuracy), yet clearly outperform the strongest MLLM (Qwen3.6-27B), which reaches 50.0% zero-shot accuracy. Our error analysis shows that MLLMs often misread the wearer’s own body, misjudge events in time, and are prone to biases such as favoring the right hand or under-counting repetitions. To narrow the gap to human performance and support further progress, we introduce a training dataset of aligned video, body motion, and language supervision, and a multimodal baseline that jointly learns from these modalities. By identifying common failure modes and missing capabilities in current MLLMs, we hope SOMA will inspire future research on body-motion understanding and multimodal reasoning. Full benchmark, training data, and code will be released at: this https URL

[NLP-79] AK_QMUL at ArGuard Shared Tasks: A Single Fine-Tuned JAIS for Arabic Harmful-Prompt Detection EMNLP2026 ACL

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决阿拉伯语有害提示检测中的两大挑战：二分类的安全/不安全判断（B1任务）与七分类的有害领域识别（B2任务）。其核心解决方案在于采用经过4-bit QLoRA微调的JAIS-6.7B作为统一骨干模型，并在其最后一层标记表示上添加线性分类头。针对B1任务，通过引入MSA（Modern Standard Arabic）数据增强训练集，构建四分类头以区分方言注册类型下的安全/不安全标签，采用argmax解码实现最终分类；针对B2任务，则将同一骨干模型微调为七分类器，并对五个随机种子的softmax输出进行平均以提升鲁棒性。该方法在两项任务中均取得最优表现，宏平均F1分别为0.984（B1）和0.790（B2），且在各方言及类别上的性能均衡，仅在“欺凌”（Bully）类别上存在因语义重叠导致的残余误差。

作者: Ali Khairallah,Arkaitz Zubiaga
机构: Queen Mary University of London (伦敦玛丽女王大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Published at ArabicNLP 2026 (Shared Tasks), co-located with EMNLP 2026. ACL Anthology: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We present AK_QMUL’s submissions to the ArGuard-2026 shared tasks on Arabic harmful-prompt detection: a binary safe/unsafe task (B1) and a seven-way harm-domain task (B2). Both submissions use one backbone – JAIS-6.7B fine-tuned with 4-bit QLoRA and a linear classification head over its last-token representation. For B1 we train a four-way head that factors the label by dialect register safe, unsafe x MSA, other, we augment the training fold with MSA prompts from AraSafe, and decode with a plain argmax to score safe/unsafe. For B2 we fine-tune the same backbone as a seven-way classifier and average the softmax outputs of five random seeds. Both submissions ranked first on their track, with macro-F1 0.984 on B1 and 0.790 on B2. We report results by dialect and by class: on B1 the model is accurate across all six dialects (93.6–99.8%) and its predicted unsafe rate tracks the true rate closely; on B2 six of the seven classes reach F1 between 0.73 and 0.98, with the residual error concentrated in the Bully class, which overlaps semantically with harassment and harm-to-others.

[NLP-80] Detect Before You Disambiguate: Perturbation-Based Input Ambiguity Detection in LLM s AACL

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在面对输入歧义时，倾向于将其视为具有单一明确含义的问题。这种处理方式忽略了输入歧义作为不确定性上游来源的本质，导致模型在未充分识别歧义的情况下即进行回答，从而影响输出的可靠性。其核心问题在于：当一个提示（prompt）存在多种合理解释时，模型是否应直接作答，还是应当首先检测并承认歧义的存在。现有方法通常依赖于模型生成的改写或澄清语句来衡量不确定性，但这类方法在测量前可能已对输入进行了隐式消歧，造成评估偏差。为此，论文提出一种标签保持性扰动框架（label-preserving perturbation framework），通过在不改变原始输入标签的前提下，施加贴近原输入的微小扰动，以实现对输入歧义的准确检测。该框架的关键创新在于区分“输入侧”与“输出侧”的不确定性检测——强调在尝试消歧之前先识别歧义。具体实现上，作者构建了两种检测器：一种是黑盒规则驱动的扰动库，另一种是基于模型内部信号的重要度引导的白盒方法。实验在四个开放域问答、对话式问答及视觉问答数据集上验证了该方法的有效性，结果表明其显著优于基于输出端不确定性估计和基于LLM重述的基线方法。研究结果强调了在消歧前进行输入歧义检测的重要性，为提升模型鲁棒性与可解释性提供了新的思路。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36353
作者: Tiejin Chen,Xiaoou Liu,Michael Clifford,Ahmadreza Moradipari,Yitao Chen,Kyungtae Han,Nejib Ammar,Hua Wei
机构: Arizona State University(亚利桑那州立大学); Toyota InfoTech Labs(丰田信息科技实验室)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted to AACL-IJCNLP 2026 Main

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) often answer ambiguous inputs as if they had a single intended meaning. This is problematic because input ambiguity is an upstream source of uncertainty: when a prompt admits multiple valid interpretations, the key question is whether the model should answer directly at all. Existing input uncertainty methods often rely on LLM-generated statements or clarifications, but such transformations may already disambiguate the input before the ambiguity is measured. We propose a label-preserving perturbation framework for input ambiguity detection in which perturbations remain close to the original input while preserving its label. We instantiate this principle with two detectors: a black-box rule-based perturbation library and a white-box importance-guided method using model-internal signals. Experiments across four datasets in open-domain, conversational, and visual QA show that our methods outperform output-side uncertainty baselines and LLM-paraphrase-based perturbation baselines. Our results highlight the importance of detecting ambiguity before attempting to disambiguate it. Our code is available \hrefthis https URL\textcolorpurplehere.

[NLP-81] Cross-modal Steering Vectors Exist Across Both Image and Text Generation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前人工智能模型中跨模态概念与机制是否实现统一，抑或在各模态间独立实现的问题。其核心关注点在于跨模态控制（cross-modal steering）：即在某一模态（如文本）上成功引导生成的向量，能否在零样本条件下（zero-shot）直接应用于另一模态（如图像）并产生一致、可解释的生成效果。区别于传统的相关性对齐方法（如表征相似性），该研究强调因果性，通过分析统一多模态模型（Unified Multimodal Models, UMMs）中语言与图像共享参数的特性，验证了跨模态转向向量的可迁移性。研究发现，无论是在情感、物体尺寸等通用概念，还是在高度依赖特定模态的语义（如正式与非正式语言）上，转向向量均能在两个方向（文本→图像、图像→文本）实现零样本转移，并表现出一致且可解释的效果（如正式风格的服装与设计）。此外，具有强跨模态可迁移性的向量在不同模态的嵌入空间中呈现出相似的几何方向，表明尽管存在显著的模态差异，但关键概念在统一模型中仍具备共通的表征结构。该研究的关键突破在于揭示了统一多模态模型中视觉与语言之间深层交互机制的存在，并为构建更普适、模态无关的可控生成方法提供了理论依据与实践路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36269
作者: Donghao Zeng(1),Nishant Subramani(2),Tamar Rott Shaham(3),Benno Krojer(1 and 4) ((1) Mila, McGill University, (2) Carnegie Mellon University, (3) MIT CSAIL, (4) Northeastern University)
机构: Mila, McGill University(蒙特利尔人工智能研究所，麦吉尔大学); Carnegie Mellon University(卡内基梅隆大学); MIT CSAIL(麻省理工学院计算机科学与人工智能实验室); Northeastern University(东北大学)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Are concepts and mechanisms unified across modalities in current AI models, or instead implemented separately for each one? We operationalize this broad question of modality unification by studying cross-modal steering: 1) finding vectors that successfully steer generation on tokens of one modality, which then 2) transfer zero-shot to steer generation when added to tokens of another modality. Our study goes beyond simple correlational alignment (e.g. representational similarity) because steering is fundamentally causal. We study cross-modal steering in several unified multimodal models (UMMs), since they possess shared parameters for language and image generation, focusing on these two modalities. Across diverse steered concepts such as emotion and object size, we show that steering vectors transfer zero-shot in both directions (text-to-image image-to-text). Even for concepts that are highly unique to one modality (e.g. formal vs. colloquial language), steering vectors often induce a consistent, interpretable effect in the other modality, such as formal clothing and design. This transfer has a geometric signature too: despite a clear modality gap separating text and image representations, steering vectors with strong cross-modal transferability tend to point in similar directions for the same concept. Our findings shed light on how vision and language interact inside unified multimodal models and point towards more general, modality-agnostic approaches for controlling their behavior.

[NLP-82] Beyond IceBERT: Open-Data ModernBERT Encoders for Icelandic from 12M to 1B Parameters

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决冰岛语（Icelandic）领域中大规模语言模型的训练效率与性能优化问题，特别是针对单语冰岛语编码器在不同规模和预训练策略下的表现。其核心问题是：是否仅通过清洗后的网络爬取数据即可训练出高性能的冰岛语编码器？以及从多语言模型进行热启动（warm-start）是否能在特定任务上带来显著优势。解决方案的关键在于采用ModernBERT架构，在90亿词元的开放数据上训练了参数量从1200万到10亿不等的30个冰岛语编码器，并在统一评估协议下对11项任务进行系统性基准测试，同时提供置信区间以增强结果可靠性。研究发现，从零开始训练的10亿参数单语冰岛语编码器在所有任务上均显著优于IceBERT；而使用相同规模的英文Ettin编码器作为热启动源时，其在所有任务上的表现均达到最优。进一步分析表明，随着模型规模增大，迁移效果主要来自源模型的Transformer层结构，即使源语言为英语也能有效提升性能；而在保持源模型词汇表的情况下，虽能避免显著性能下降，但会带来高达5点的F1分数损失及近三倍的计算开销，凸显了词汇表移植的代价。因此，关键突破在于验证了跨语言热启动在大规模单语模型中的有效性，并揭示了模型结构与词汇表选择之间的权衡关系。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36230
作者: Hafsteinn Einarsson
机构: University of Iceland(冰岛大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 20 pages, 1 figure, 11 tables. Models: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:IceBERT, the reference encoder for Icelandic, found that a cleaned web crawl is enough to train a strong model and that starting from a multilingual model can help on some tasks. We revisit both findings with the ModernBERT architecture. We train Icelandic encoders from 12M to 1B parameters on 9B tokens of open data, and rerun IceBERT’s benchmarks and five newer tasks for 30 encoders under one protocol with confidence intervals. Our 1B model trained from scratch, to our knowledge the first monolingual Icelandic encoder of that size, is significantly better than IceBERT on all eleven tasks; warm-started from the English Ettin encoder of the same shape, it has the best score of all encoders on every task we rank. Because our model shapes match the English Ettin encoders and the multilingual mmBERT, we can also test the warm start under controlled conditions, at six model sizes and four token budgets. With our vocabulary transplanted, a warm start was never significantly worse than scratch training on the same Icelandic text, and from base size up it was not significantly worse on four tasks than scratch training on 4 times the text (8 times at base and 1B). As models grow, most of the transfer comes from the source model’s transformer layers, so even an English source helps. Keeping the source vocabulary instead cost 5 F1 on question answering and nearly three times the compute.

[NLP-83] Base Models Can Detect Hidden Intentions that Prompted Classifiers Miss

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大模型在后训练（post-training）过程中可能隐含并传递未明确声明的潜在人格特征（persona）的问题，尤其是这些特征以隐蔽信号的形式嵌入到模型生成的看似无关的内容中（如数字序列）。其核心挑战在于如何检测和识别这些潜藏于模型输出中的非显性偏好或意图，而传统方法难以捕捉此类细微偏差。解决方案的关键是提出一种名为“人格头似然评估”（Persona-Header Likelihood Evaluation, PHLE）的方法：通过在基础预训练模型上添加特定的“人格头”（persona header），并计算生成输出在该头部下的似然值，从而解码出隐藏的子意识信号。实验表明，即使经过去偏处理、使生成内容表面无明显异常，PHLE仍能有效区分不同人格驱动下的输出（如“喜爱猫头鹰”与“喜爱鹰”），且该信号在不同模型家族间具有跨模型迁移性（如Qwen与Olmo之间的信号可被读取），验证了人格选择模型（PSM）的非平凡预测能力。该方法为检测和审计模型内部隐藏目标提供了可操作的技术路径。

作者: Oz Amram
机构: 独立研究人员(Independent)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 28 pages, 10 figures. Code available at this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The Persona Selection Model (PSM) posits that post-training selects a persona the model learned during pre-training. Work on subliminal learning has shown that models can impart covert signals (like “love of owls”) into semantically unrelated outputs like strings of numbers, and that students trained on these outputs inherit those traits. In this work I show that by evaluating the likelihood of such outputs under the base pre-trained model with an appropriate header, a method I call persona-header likelihood evaluation (PHLE), one can decode these subliminal signals and classify between them. For example, PHLE distinguishes number sequences generated by a post-trained model prompted with “You love owls” from those prompted with “You love eagles”, and distinguishes answers from a model with a secret desire to harm the user, filtered to remove any noticeable misalignment, from those of a model with no system prompt. In both cases prompted classifiers, including the generating model itself, remain near chance. The signal partially persists across model families, with the Qwen base model reading signals generated by Olmo and vice versa. This is evidence for a non-trivial prediction of the PSM, and the method may be practically useful for auditing the hidden objectives of models.

[NLP-84] Learning to Read Braille: Benchmarking and Improving Braille Recognition Capabilities of VLMs

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模态系统在真实世界场景下从图像中读取盲文（Braille）这一关键可及性任务中的性能瓶颈问题。当前主流视觉语言模型（VLMs）在直接转录盲文图像方面表现不佳，暴露出在特定无障碍应用场景下的能力缺陷。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个高质量的实拍盲文图像基准测试集——BrailleBench，涵盖259张真实的Grade-1与Grade-2盲文图像，并设计了一套包含多样化版式与图像扰动的合成盲文生成流水线。通过在该合成数据上训练的20亿参数级视觉语言模型，实现了对Grade-1盲文87%的精确匹配率和Grade-2盲文61%的精确匹配率，显著优于独立运行的一般性多模态模型，且在所评估系统中达到最高的Grade-2盲文转录准确率。研究还揭示了模型在合成验证集上高精度并不等同于在真实照片上的高性能，强调了针对真实场景进行针对性合成监督的重要性，从而为提升盲文图像识别的鲁棒性与实用性提供了有效路径。

作者: Kartik Jangra,Atharva Gawane,Siddharth Pulipaka,Hemachandran Karah,Raj Dabre
机构: Nilekani Centre at AI4Bharat; Indian Institute of Technology, Madras; Mahindra University
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 22 pages, 8 figures, 16 tables. Code and data: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Despite rapid progress in visual understanding and document transcription, modern vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with a fundamental accessibility task: reading Braille from images. We introduce BrailleBench, a manually curated benchmark of 259 real-world Grade-1 and Grade-2 Braille images. We evaluate proprietary, open-weight, OCR-specialized, and tool-assisted multimodal systems and find that standalone general-purpose models perform poorly at directly transcribing Braille images, whereas tool-assisted systems perform much better. We design a synthetic Braille generation pipeline with diverse layouts and image perturbations. A 2B VLM model trained on our synthetic data reaches 87% exact match on Grade-1 and 61% on Grade-2 BrailleBench, outperforming standalone VLMs and achieving the highest Grade-2 exact match score among the evaluated systems. We further show that high accuracy on synthetic validation data does not guarantee high accuracy on real photographs in our experiments: models trained on prior synthetic data reach up to 96% on their synthetic validation set but at most 3.26% on Grade-1 BrailleBench. Our results identify an accessibility-relevant capability gap in multimodal systems and show that targeted synthetic supervision can improve real-world Braille transcription.

[NLP-85] LLM Hallucination Detection via Low-rank Multilinear Decomposition

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在生成回答时频繁出现流畅但事实性错误（即幻觉，Hallucination）的问题，尤其关注如何从高维隐藏状态中有效提取具有判别性的信息以提升幻觉检测的准确性。现有方法多依赖于特定激活值或基于池化的压缩策略，往往忽略分布在Transformer各层、特征模态及词元间的潜在判别信息。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为LOTUS（Low-rank Order-statistic TUcker-based Subspace learning）的多线性低秩分解框架：首先利用互补的统计描述符对变长词元表示进行总结，捕捉峰值激活、激活分布及跨层变化等关键特征；随后通过低秩多线性分解技术提取能够反映LLM隐藏状态底层结构的紧凑表征，并用于训练轻量级幻觉分类器。该方法显著降低了对标注数据的依赖，同时在多个大模型和问答基准上实现了优于当前先进基线的幻觉检测性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36191
作者: Devansh Sharma,Faizul Rakib Sayem,Shahana Ibrahim
机构: University of Central Florida (中佛罗里达大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 26 pages, 3 figures. Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) frequently generate fluent yet factually incorrect responses, raising concerns about their reliability. Recent hallucination detectors increasingly exploit internal representations, but extracting informative signals from high-dimensional hidden states remains challenging. Existing approaches often rely on selected activations or pooling-based compression, potentially overlooking discriminative information distributed across Transformer layers, feature modes, and tokens. We propose LOTUS (Low-rank Order-statistic TUcker-based Subspace learning), a multilinear low-rank decomposition framework for hallucination detection that extracts compact representations from LLM hidden states while reducing dependence on labeled data. Our approach first summarizes variable-length token representations using complementary statistical descriptors that capture peak activations, activation distributions, and cross-layer changes. We then leverage low-rank multilinear decomposition to extract compact representations that capture the underlying structure of LLM hidden states, which are subsequently used to train a lightweight hallucination classifier. Experiments across multiple LLMs and question-answering benchmarks demonstrate improved hallucination detection performance over recent state-of-the-art baselines.

[NLP-86] Frankly Speaking: The Company Election Integrity Keeps in Congressional Communication

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决美国政治中两党对“选举诚信”（election integrity）概念理解日益分化的问题，揭示尽管两党使用相同的词汇，却通过语境差异构建出截然不同的叙事。其解决方案的关键在于运用历时词嵌入（diachronic word embeddings）技术，分析2010至2025年间国会发送的10,420封电子邮件新闻简报，追踪“诚信”“安全”“欺诈”等关键词在语义上的演变及其共现模式。研究发现，两党并未依赖不同词汇传递不同含义，而是通过将相同词汇置于迥异的语境之中实现意义分化；例如，民主党将“选民”“选举”“诚信”与“投票权”“行政管理”等词汇关联，强调扩大参与和程序公平；而共和党则将其与“公民身份验证”“非法投票”“边境安全”等关联，聚焦于防止非资格选票。这种语义邻近性的根本分歧虽在整体词汇频率层面不显著，但关键术语如“认证”“被操纵”“被盗”自2020年后显著极化，凸显了选举话语的政治分裂。最终，选举官员需在两种相互矛盾的定义下维持同一套制度运行，承受由此产生的结构性张力。

机构: Vermont Complex Systems Institute, University of Vermont(佛蒙特复杂系统研究所，佛蒙特大学); Community Development and Applied Economics, University of Vermont(社区发展与应用经济学，佛蒙特大学); Department of Computer Science, University of Vermont(计算机科学系，佛蒙特大学); Complexity Science Hub, Vienna(复杂性科学中心，维也纳)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Election integrity is a shared commitment in American politics, but Democrats and Republicans in Congress increasingly mean different things by it. Analyzing 10,420 congressional e-newsletters sent from 2010 to 2025, we examine how the two parties invoke election terms such as integrity,'' security,‘’ and fraud.'' Using diachronic word embeddings, which track semantic change through how words are used in context, we measure how differently each party uses each term, how much each party shifts, and whether they share nearest semantic neighbors. We show that members of Congress do not need different words to tell different stories about elections. They need only place those same words in different company. Across nearly every term and year, the two parties surround election-integrity vocabulary with entirely different words. That divergence is easy to miss, because most election vocabulary is no more divergent than other words used at roughly the same frequency, and neither party's usage shifted more than the other's. Only a subset of terms grew more divergent, most notably certification,‘’ while rigged'' and stolen’’ entered election discourse after 2020 and polarized there. By 2024, Democrats surround voter,'' election,‘’ and integrity'' with the language of access and administration. Republicans surround the same terms with citizenship verification,‘’ noncitizen voting,'' and border security.‘’ For one party, integrity means protecting eligible voters’ ability to cast a ballot. For the other, it means protecting the electoral process from illegitimate ballots. Election officials, who must administer a single system under both definitions, inherit this tension.

[NLP-87] Lipi-Ghor: A Large-Scale Diarized Multi-Domain Bengali Speech Corpus and a Scalable Pipeline for Building It

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决孟加拉语在语音识别领域严重资源匮乏的问题，特别是针对现有公开的孟加拉语自动语音识别（ASR）语料库普遍存在的短时、朗读或众包语音、缺乏说话人分离（speaker diarization）以及长时音频标注的局限性。其核心解决方案是构建Lipi-Ghor——一个大规模弱监督的孟加拉语语音语料库，包含来自998个YouTube视频的885小时音频，覆盖17个多样化领域（如有声书、戏剧、宗教布道、新闻及地方方言），并采用SSTT格式（说话人、语音、转录、时间戳）进行标注，结合自动化说话人分离与YouTube字幕自动生成转录。该工作首次实现了低资源语言中大规模、说话人分离且具有长时结构的音频标注，突破了以往资源规模与质量的瓶颈。关键创新在于提出了一套可复现的构建管道，通过针对性筛选高质量视频源渠道，在无需大量人工标注的前提下实现对低资源语言的大规模语料扩展。此外，为应对字幕噪声问题，研究团队还发布了由17名志愿者历时30小时人工校验的黄金评估集，并开放原始贡献数据（视频ID列表、说话人分离输出、代码及黄金标注）以供研究使用，而仅提供基于字幕生成的转录文本用于学术研究，不提供原始音频文件。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36184
作者: Sanjid Hasan,A H M Fuad,Risalat Labib,Bayazid Hasan Simon
机构: Khulna University of Engineering & Technology (KUET)( khulna 工程与技术大学); Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET)( 孟加拉国工程与技术大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 12 pages, 7 figures. Published in the Proceedings of the Speech and Audio Language Models Workshop (2nd Edition), pages 190-201, 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Bengali, spoken by over 230 million people, remains severely under-resourced in spoken language research. Existing open Bengali ASR corpora are confined to short, read or crowd-sourced speech and lack speaker diarization and long-form audio. We present Lipi-Ghor, a large-scale weakly-supervised Bengali speech corpus comprising 885 hours of audio sourced from 998 YouTube videos across 596 unique channels, spanning 17 diverse domains including audiobooks, drama, religious sermons, news, and regional dialects. Each recording is annotated in SSTT format (Speaker, Speech, Transcription, Timestamp), which combines automated diarization with Bengali YouTube caption tracks. To our knowledge, Lipi-Ghor is the first Bengali speech corpus to pair large-scale coverage with speaker-diarized, long-form audio annotations, both of which are absent from existing open Bengali resources. We also present the construction methodology as a replicable pipeline for any language with a sufficient captioned YouTube presence. Targeted channel curation across a handful of rich domains yields corpus scales that were previously out of reach for low-resource languages. We benchmark four widely-used ASR models under zero-shot and fine-tuned conditions. All four degrade consistently on emotive, dialectal, and long-form content. Because caption targets are noisy, we also release a human-annotated gold evaluation split, verified by 17 volunteer annotators over 30 hours of human-in-the-loop correction and stratified across all 17 domains. We release our original contributions (video-ID lists, diarization output, pipeline code, and the gold annotations) under CC-BY-4.0, and distribute caption-derived transcripts for research use only; no raw audio is redistributed. Comments: 12 pages, 7 figures. [NLP-88] 3 7 14 17 42: Instruction Tuning Installs and Sharpens Number-Choice Heuristics in Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语言模型在生成随机整数时概率分布建模中存在的采样误差问题，传统方法依赖于蒙特卡洛采样估计概率，引入噪声并影响结果的准确性。其核心解决方案是通过精确计算每个整数从1到N的“拼写得分”（scored spellings）之和，直接获得无采样误差的概率分布，从而实现对模型输出分布的精确测量。该方法在18个开源模型系列、5个不同数值范围（最高至N=100）、29种解码配置及两个推理栈上进行评估，揭示了指令微调（instruction tuning）对分布特性的影响：显著降低分布均匀性，引入“圆整数回避”（round-number avoidance）与强化“端点回避”（endpoint avoidance），且仅在N=100时出现一致的奇数偏好。这些行为部分契合人类数字选择的心理学模型（Kubovy & Psotka, 1987），但圆整数回避并非人类认知模型的一部分，且其中预测的中点回避现象几乎不存在。此外，指令微调并未在不同模型间建立共享的首选整数，多数条件下无共同主导值，表明模型内部分布仍保持较高多样性。关键发现在于，通过非采样式精确计算，可揭示模型内在分布特征，为理解生成式AI中的决策偏差提供可靠依据。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36178
作者: Samar Ansari
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We measure, without sampling error, the probability a language model assigns to each integer from 1 to N when asked for a random number. For a fixed prompt the model defines one probability vector, which we compute by summing over each integer’s scored spellings rather than estimate by sampling, removing the noise that limits earlier studies [1, 4]. We evaluate 18 open-weight model lines at five ranges up to N = 100, under 29 decoding configurations, on two inference stacks; 15 of them have matched base and instruction-tuned checkpoints that both give usable answers. Instruction tuning makes the distribution less uniform in all 15 pairs. It installs one heuristic, round-number avoidance, and sharpens another, endpoint avoidance. Base checkpoints do not avoid round numbers once the endpoints are removed from those sets; tuned checkpoints avoid them, multiples of 10 almost completely. Base checkpoints return the endpoints 1 and N at 0.30 to 0.60 of the interior rate; tuned checkpoints almost never return them. A preference for odd numbers is consistent across tuned checkpoints only at N = 100, where base checkpoints also show it weakly. Endpoint avoidance and the odd preference fit the account Kubovy and Psotka [6] proposed for human number choice; round-number avoidance is not part of that account, and the midpoint avoidance it predicts is essentially absent, with one slight exception at N = 100. Tuning does not install a new favourite integer shared across models: above N = 10 no modal integer is shared by more than 42 percent of tuned conditions, and P (17) rises in 10 of 15 pairs and falls in 5. The concentration is present in the model’s own distribution: at temperature 1.0, nucleus truncation at top-p 0.95 adds a median of 0.035 to the total variation distance.

[NLP-89] Dont Pick a Winner: Knowledge Conflicts Need a Prior Not a Rule

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决检索增强型语言模型（Retrieval-Augmented Language Model, RALM）在检索上下文与模型自身知识存在冲突时的决策难题。现有方法依赖于设计时固定的规则来处理分歧，如优先采纳上下文、按偏离程度放大上下文影响或信任模型记忆，但这些规则在特定部署场景下均会失效。其根本问题在于：固定规则的性能随可靠上下文比例呈线性变化，而最优性能应为凸函数，导致任何固定规则在非最优情况下必然被超越；且当前方法所依赖的对称性偏差无法提供判断哪一方正确的信息。为此，论文提出需同时具备两个关键输入：分别评估每个来源（上下文与模型知识）的独立证据，以及上下文正确的先验概率。作者在GRACE基准上验证了这一理论，该基准可独立测量模型知识、上下文内容与真实事实。实验表明，所有来自四个基线家族的方法仅在正确或错误上下文中表现良好，无法兼顾两者。为此，研究构建了双输入系统：模型以“笔记”形式表达知识，小型策略网络为每条笔记赋予校准置信度，阅读器以双重声音生成回答，选择器则在给定先验π下决定采纳或弃权，实现精确先验偏移。当π设置为真实正确上下文比例时，该系统在所有GRACE上下文混合比例下均显著优于最佳基线，最高提升26分，整体得分达45.3（Qwen3.5-35B-A3B）和35.0（Llama-3.1-8B），远超基线的29.4和27.5；在预注册的ClashEval测试中，亦分别领先同骨干模型的CK-PLUG与TCR达12和26分。当模型缺乏知识时，性能增益消失，符合理论预测。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36169
作者: Minh Pham Van,Cong Tran
机构: Posts and Telecommunications Institute of Technology (越南邮电技术学院)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 49 pages (9 main text + appendix and supplementary material), 14 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A retrieval-augmented language model answers from two sources, the retrieved context and its own knowledge, and the two disagree whenever the context is incomplete or wrong. Existing methods settle the disagreement with a rule fixed at design time: follow the context, amplify it in proportion to how far it moves the model, or trust the model’s memory. Each rule is confidently wrong in some deployment. In a decision-theoretic model of two sources, the score of any fixed rule is linear in the share of reliable contexts while the best attainable score is convex, so every fixed rule is beaten wherever it is not exactly optimal; and a symmetric divergence between the two sources, the signal adaptive decoding uses, carries no information about which one is right. Resolving a conflict therefore needs two inputs that no existing method keeps: evidence about each source separately, and a prior on how often the context is right. We test these claims on GRACE, a benchmark that intervenes on the knowledge-graph context of a fixed question, so that what the model knows, what the context says and what is true are measured separately. There, every baseline from four families is strong on right contexts or on wrong ones, never on both. We then build the two inputs: the model states its knowledge as notes, a small policy voices each note with a calibrated confidence, a reader answers in two voices, and a selector commits or abstains under a prior \pi applied as an exact prior shift. With \pi set to the true share of right contexts, the system is above the best baseline at every mixture of GRACE contexts, by up to 26 points. Its overall score is 45.3 and 35.0 (Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, Llama-3.1-8B), against 29.4 and 27.5 for the best baseline. On preregistered ClashEval it beats same-backbone CK-PLUG and TCR by 12 and 26 points. Where the model lacks the knowledge, the gains vanish, as the theory predicts.

[NLP-90] ConformalMOS: Uncertainty-Aware MOS Prediction with Conformal Intervals and Ordinal Modeling

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有语音质量评估中主观评价指标——人类平均意见分（Mean Opinion Score, MOS）预测模型仅输出点估计而忽略不确定性的问题，这限制了其在模型选择与实际部署中的可靠性。针对此问题，论文提出ConformalMOS框架，通过引入共形预测（conformal prediction）技术，生成具有统计保证的预测区间（prediction intervals），在交换性假设下可确保覆盖率，同时保留点估计输出。其核心解决方案在于：在训练阶段采用序数感知（ordinal-aware）的标签建模方式，将原始的one-hot标签转化为高斯平滑分布，从而在保持评分顺序关系的同时提升不确定性校准能力，尤其有效缓解softmax置信度在分布外（out-of-distribution）语音样本上过度自信的问题。实验结果表明，ConformalMOS在BVCC数据集上实现了优异的预测精度（MSE = 0.08），并验证了预测区间的实际覆盖率，显著提升了文本到语音（TTS）与语音转换（VC）系统在真实场景部署中的可靠性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36126
作者: Kehinde Elelu,Joshua E. Siegel,Mohammadali Saffary,Tashfain Ahmed,Simeon Babatunde,Ebuka Okpala
机构: 未知
类目: ound (cs.SD); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Accurate prediction of human Mean Opinion Scores (MOS) is crucial for evaluating synthetic speech quality in text-to-speech (TTS) and voice conversion (VC). Most MOS predictors output only point estimates and ignore uncertainty, limiting reliability in model selection and deployment. We propose ConformalMOS, a framework that augments MOS prediction with conformal prediction to produce statistically valid prediction intervals with guaranteed coverage under exchangeability, alongside point estimates. During training, MOS labels are modeled in an ordinal-aware manner by converting one-hot targets into Gaussian-smoothed distributions, preserving score ordering. This improves uncertainty calibration, particularly when softmax confidence is overconfident on out-of-distribution speech. On BVCC datasets, ConformalMOS achieves competitive accuracy (MSE = 0.08) while delivering empirically validated coverage, enhancing reliability for real-world TTS and VC deployment.

[NLP-91] Beyond Update Counts: A Control Map for Evaluating Test-Time Model Updates

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有测试时更新（test-time updating）评估方法中对更新过程信息缺失的问题，即当前评估通常仅关注更新次数或频率及即时性能表现，却忽略了更新内容、位置、时机与顺序等关键细节，导致相同总更新量下可能掩盖系统间本质差异。其解决方案的核心是提出**控制图（Control Map）**这一新型评估框架，通过记录每次评分答案前已提交的更新历史，实现对行为变化、即时学习（acquisition）、后续回忆（retention）、无关行为保持性（locality）以及新场景下性能的独立评估。研究证明，在特定假设条件下，更新次数可决定最终状态，并揭示了预答更新历史差异对平均得分差异的限制关系。实验结果表明：更新调度策略显著影响性能（相同更新次数下准确率波动达19.7%–34.2%）；学习新信息并不保证其持久性或局部性（如ROME虽在所有操作点保留编辑，但均破坏局部性）；且无任何编辑器在不同模型、基准和测试中始终最优。因此，论文强调评估应报告完整的更新历史，并分别考察学习获取、记忆保持与局部性，以实现更全面、透明的评测。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36109
作者: Zehao Zhao,Shangjian Yin,Rui Liu,Chongyang Bai,Mark Ibrahim,Kavosh Asadi,Yuchen Lu,Hang Cui,Hamed Firooz
机构: Meta AI(元宇宙人工智能实验室)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 44 pages, 6 figures, including appendices

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Test-time updating lets a language model change persistent state after training—such as model weights, adapter parameters, or a memory module—before or while answering queries. Existing evaluations often compare systems using update count or frequency and performance measured immediately afterward. These summaries omit what is updated, where, when, and in what order. The same total can therefore hide an important difference: one system may answer after one update while another answers after two. We introduce the Control Map, an evaluation framework that records the committed updates preceding each scored answer and separately evaluates behavioral changes, immediate learning (acquisition), later recall (retention), preservation of unrelated behavior (locality), and performance in new settings. We prove when counts alone determine final state and show, under stated assumptions, how differences between pre-answer histories limit differences in average scores. Using ControlMap, our experiments reveal three insights. First, update scheduling matters: at a 760M-parameter checkpoint, 24 schedules with the same update count yield 19.7%–34.2% accuracy. Second, learning an edit does not guarantee that it lasts or remains contained: all six selected CounterFact LoRA settings learn the new information, while ROME retains edits at all 13 operating points but fails locality at each. Third, no editor performs best consistently across models, benchmarks, and tests. Evaluations should therefore report update histories and assess acquisition, retention, and locality separately.

[NLP-92] FinLLM -KG: Knowledge Graph-Enhanced LLM s for Financial Sentiment Analysis in Algorithmic Trading

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有生成式AI在金融情感分析中面临的两大核心问题：一是现有方法仅孤立地预测单篇财经文章的情感倾向，缺乏对上下文和公司整体背景的充分理解；二是模型决策过程呈现“黑箱”特性，难以解释，限制了其在高风险金融决策场景中的可信部署。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种模型无关的框架FinLLM-KG，通过在推理阶段动态注入来自美国证券交易委员会（SEC）10-K文件的时序化、企业级知识图谱（financial knowledge graph, KG）信息，无需更新模型权重即可增强上下文感知能力。该框架支持以自然语言公司概况或经相关性排序的事实三元组形式提供上下文，使情感分析能够融合企业层面的宏观信息，实现近乎零计算成本的扩展。同时，通过将文章级情感得分归因于具体句子及知识图谱中的事实，显著提升了模型输出的可解释性，支持人工介入审查。实验表明，FinLLM-KG在投资组合绩效上持续优于当前最优基线，验证了其在实际金融应用中的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36083
作者: Giorgos Iacovides,Oliver Hannibal,Wuyang Zhou,Danilo Mandic
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Statistical Finance (q-fin.ST); Trading and Market Microstructure (q-fin.TR)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recent advances in Generative AI have substantially improved financial sentiment analysis through post-trained financial large language models (LLMs). However, existing approaches remain confined to predicting the sentiment of each article in isolation and operate as black boxes, which limits contextual understanding and hinders deployment in high-stakes financial decision-making. To this end, we introduce FinLLM-KG, a model-agnostic framework that combines causal LLMs with a financial knowledge graph, in order to inject temporally grounded, company-level knowledge from SEC 10-K filings at inference time, without updating model weights. Within FinLLM-KG, context is supplied either as a natural-language company profile or as a small set of relevance-ranked factual triples. This enables sentiment predictions to account for broader firm-level information rather than the article alone, at almost zero computational cost and for any causal LLM. In addition, attributing each article-level sentiment score to individual sentences and to the retrieved knowledge-graph facts makes the evidence behind the prediction inspectable, thereby enhancing explainability and supporting human-in-the-loop review. Simulations demonstrate that FinLLM-KG consistently improves portfolio performance over the state-of-the-art baseline.

[NLP-93] How Much Does the Hint Matter? Scope Conditions for Hindsight Self-Distillation in Financial Reasoning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在数据本地化约束下，金融领域应用中等规模开源模型（open-weight models）因无法部署前沿大模型而导致多步定量推理能力显著落后的问题。其核心挑战在于：传统基于策略的蒸馏（on-policy distillation, OPD）依赖强外部教师模型提供监督信号，而纯自蒸馏（on-policy self-distillation, OPSD）则需完整的参考解作为条件，导致实际应用受限。为此，论文提出一种名为Fin-SD的局部回溯式自蒸馏方法，其关键创新在于无需外部模型参与梯度计算，仅通过学生模型自身识别首次错误推理步骤，并生成简短批判性提示（hint），随后将该提示与前缀状态联合输入一个冻结的学生副本作为“教师”，以反向KL散度进行短周期蒸馏。该方法强调监督信号的位置而非内容本身，实证表明：（i）使用通用反馈替代具体批判性提示仍可获得3.03个百分点的准确率提升，说明性能增益主要源于监督位置的设计；（ii）生成提示的模型无需强于接收提示的模型，同家族更大参数量的GPT-OSS-120B所生成提示并未带来实质性优势；（iii）Fin-SD在保持与全参考解自蒸馏相当的准确率的同时，减少9.5%的生成token数，且在MMLU-Pro通用推理和FinTrust合规审计任务上未出现明显性能退化。因此，解决方案的关键在于构建一种轻量化、无外部依赖、基于内部反思的高效自蒸馏机制，实现高质量推理能力的本地化迁移。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36082
作者: Johnny Yu,Cyril Gorlla
机构: University of California, Berkeley (加州大学伯克利分校); CTGT (CTGT)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 8 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the 7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF '26), Milan, Italy. Code and data: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Financial institutions operating under data-residency constraints are restricted to open-weight models small enough to locally host, which trail frontier systems on multi-step quantitative reasoning. On-policy distillation narrows such gaps by supervising a student on its own rollouts, but traditional OPD requires a strong external teacher, and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) conditions on a full reference solution. We ask how much of that signal is necessary. We present Fin-SD, a localized hindsight self-distillation recipe for multi-step reasoning. Given a problem the student fails, the student itself identifies the first incorrect reasoning step and writes a short critique of that step. We truncate the student’s trajectory immediately before the error (aiming to obtain a correct prefix), condition a frozen copy of the student on the same prefix plus the hint, and distill that hint-conditioned teacher into the student over a short rollout under reverse KL. No external model contributes a gradient. We apply Fin-SD to GPT-OSS-20B on a custom multi-step financial reasoning benchmark that requires deriving formula inputs from realistic scenarios via accounting conventions. We find: (i) replacing the critique with a generic-feedback control matches Fin-SD’s entire 3.03 pp accuracy gain over the base model on the FinanceReasoning Hard subset, suggesting the gain comes from where supervision is applied, not hint content; (ii) the model writing the hint does not need to be stronger than the model receiving it: hints from same-family GPT-OSS-120B, at roughly 6x the parameters, yield no materially greater benefits than self-written hints; and (iii) Fin-SD matches on-policy self-distillation from full reference solutions on accuracy while generating 9.5% fewer tokens. With Fin-SD, general reasoning on MMLU-Pro and a fourteen-metric compliance audit on FinTrust show no material regression.

[NLP-94] OmniBrain-0: A Unified Agent ic Model for Embodied Intelligence

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决通用具身智能（general-purpose embodied intelligence）中机器人在长时程任务中协调多样化技能、持续追踪任务进展并实现失败恢复的难题。现有方法中，专用策略（specialist policies）难以保障任务级可靠性，而高性能多模态代理依赖于昂贵的推理过程和外部经验，难以被轻量级模型复现。为此，本文提出OmniBrain-0——一种轻量级统一具身智能体，通过共享高层决策模型协同操作与导航，集成任务理解、规划、进度追踪及反馈驱动的故障恢复能力。其核心解决方案在于采用渐进式训练框架，融合具身预训练、领域专精代理蒸馏以及多教师在线策略蒸馏（Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation, MOPD），将强教师模型的交互经验提炼为操作与导航专家，并将其决策能力统一整合至OmniBrain-0的决策模型中，实现决策层面的真正统一而非仅限于工具接口层。进一步引入基于评分标准的递归自改进（Rubric-Guided Recursive Self-Improvement, RSI）数据飞轮机制，由元智能体（Meta-Agent）将执行证据转化为精细化评分标准、步骤提醒及验证轨迹，用于更新领域专家，再通过MOPD重新整合至OmniBrain-0。实验在LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-Plus、RoboCasa365、RoboTwin 2.0、R2R-CE Val-Unseen及多个真实世界操作任务上验证，结果表明OmniBrain-0在跨域任务表现上具备竞争力，同时显著降低推理与执行开销，实现了具身能力高效迁移与紧凑化统一。

Abstract:General-purpose embodied intelligence requires robots to coordinate diverse skills over long horizons, track task progress, and recover from failures. Specialist policies alone do not ensure task-level reliability, while powerful multimodal agents rely on costly reasoning and external experience that compact models struggle to reproduce. We introduce OmniBrain-0, a lightweight unified embodied agent that coordinates manipulation and navigation through a shared high-level decision model, integrating task understanding, planning, progress tracking, and feedback-driven recovery. Our progressive training framework combines embodied pretraining, domain-specialized agent distillation, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). It distills powerful teachers’ interaction experience into manipulation and navigation experts, then consolidates their decision capabilities into OmniBrain-0. Unification therefore occurs within the learned decision model rather than only at the tool interface. We further introduce Rubric-Guided Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI), a data flywheel in which a Meta-Agent turns execution evidence into refined rubrics, step-level reminders, and verified trajectories for domain-expert updates before their reconsolidation into OmniBrain-0 through MOPD. We evaluate OmniBrain-0 on LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-Plus, RoboCasa365, RoboTwin 2.0, and R2R-CE Val-Unseen, as well as multiple real-world manipulation tasks. OmniBrain-0 combines strong cross-domain task performance with substantially lower inference and execution overhead than its closed-source teacher, demonstrating efficient transfer and consolidation of embodied capabilities into a compact unified agent.

[NLP-95] MedJev: Evaluating Zero-Shot System-One Decision Making in Medicine

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决临床决策支持系统中生成式AI（Generative AI）模型计算成本高、推理延迟大以及预测置信度校准不足的问题。其核心挑战在于如何在保持低计算资源消耗的同时，实现与大型语言模型（LLM）相当的医学知识理解与患者层面预测性能，并确保模型输出的置信度具有良好的校准性。解决方案的关键在于提出一种轻量级、仅需两个参数的再校准方法（recalibration method），通过利用50至200个本地标注样本对模型预测进行微调，显著提升置信度校准质量（将ECE从0.286降至0.007），同时维持模型在本地设备上运行的高效性。实验表明，MedJev作为开源的System One模型，在多项医学基准测试中接近GPT-4性能，且在住院死亡率预测任务中优于传统机器学习模型（如XGBoost），验证了其作为医疗AI零样本基线的潜力。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:System One decision models such as Jev answer structured questions in a single forward pass without generating text, offering fast and computationally efficient clinical decision support. We evaluate MedJev, an open System One model that runs locally on a laptop, across ten medical benchmarks spanning medical knowledge, diagnosis, and patient level prediction using MIMIC IV and MIMIC IV ED. We compare MedJev against zero shot LLM baselines, published GPT results, and supervised models. MedJev achieves accuracies of 72.5 percent on MedQA, 75.4 percent on USMLE, and 80.1 percent on NEJM, approaching published GPT 4 performance while maintaining well calibrated confidence estimates (ECE 0.028 to 0.063). On patient level tasks, MedJev achieves an AUROC of 0.926 for In Hospital Mortality, exceeding XGBoost (0.902), but underperforms supervised models on operational outcomes such as ED Triage Admission (0.745 vs. 0.809). Patient level predictions also exhibit substantial miscalibration (In Hospital Mortality ECE 0.286). We introduce a lightweight, two parameter recalibration method that adapts predictions to local patient populations using 50 to 200 labeled examples, reducing ECE to 0.007. Our findings establish open System One models as a promising zero shot baseline for medical AI, combining competitive predictive performance with low computational cost and efficient local calibration. We release our code and evaluation harness to support future research.

[NLP-96] ReCoPII: A Relation-Grounded Framework for Building Contextual PII Masking Datasets

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式隐私信息识别（PII）标注数据时面临的“真实数据不可得”难题，即在隐私保护限制下难以获取可用于训练上下文掩码系统的带标签真实数据。传统方法如基于作者的增强（SPY）依赖单一数据主体假设，将与作者无关的实体标记为非PII，但忽略了多主体场景下的复杂关系，导致标注偏差。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为ReCoPII（关系引导的上下文PII掩码）的新框架：该框架通过构建符合本体约束的实体关系图谱，设计带有占位符的插入句，利用代码自动化重构标注，并通过独立的大语言模型（LLM）验证结果，最终依据实体间的关系推导出MASK/KEEP标签。该方法无需依赖单一数据主体假设，从而生成更准确、更具泛化能力的标注数据。实验表明，基于该框架构建的ReCoPII-Ko语料库在六个韩语文档领域中实现了高一致性（四名标注者对采样保留标签的同意率达88.42%，远超SPY方法的26.27%），且基于该数据训练的分类器在测试集上过掩码率显著降低。进一步地，联合微调上下文掩码系统与PII检测器，在固定泄露预算下有效缓解了仅依赖检测器时的过掩码问题；在人工验证的实体记录上，四个检测器的过掩码率均不超过5.04%，泄露率不超过4.18%。此外，所提出的检测器在KDPII基准上性能接近XLM-R-large，但参数量仅为后者的约四分之一，展现出优异的效率与效果平衡。

Abstract:Training contextual masking systems for personally identifiable information (PII) requires examples distinguishing maskable from preservable mentions of one entity type, but privacy restrictions limit access to real data. Author-based augmentation (SPY) labels mentions unrelated to the author as non-PII, presuming a single data subject and overlooking others. We propose ReCoPII (Relation-grounded Contextual PII masking), a framework that builds such data without this premise: it plans ontology-constrained entity relations, writes insertion sentences with placeholders, reconstructs annotations with code, checks the result with a separate LLM, and derives MASK/KEEP labels from entity relations. On Korean documents from six domains, it yields ReCoPII-Ko, a corpus with relation, privacy, and MASK/KEEP annotations, which we validate. Across 300 pairs, four annotators agree with 88.42% of its sampled KEEP labels, against 26.27% for SPY-style augmentation of the same sources. Classifiers trained on it over-mask less than under that reference on a matched test. Contextual masking fine-tuned jointly with a PII detector removes most over-masking of detection alone within a fixed leakage budget; on human-verified entity records, the four detectors meeting it over-mask at most 5.04% with at most 4.18% leakage. The detector is comparable to XLM-R-large on KDPII with about a quarter of its parameters.

[NLP-97] Physiognomy Revisited: How Vision-Language Models Encode Sensitive Attributes Through Image Transformation EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能（Generative AI）在视觉语言模型（VLMs）中对受保护身份（如种族、性取向等）的编码与生成过程中所隐含的偏见与不可预测的失效模式问题，尤其关注这些缺陷对弱势群体可能造成的不平等影响。其解决方案的关键在于揭示：当要求模型将人脸图像转换为特定种族或性取向特征时，模型表现出非确定性、群体敏感性的响应行为，生成图像在统计上可区分且往往强化既有刻板印象；进一步发现，此类生成阶段引入的表征偏差会传递至后续文本推理与人物描述任务中，甚至扩展至犯罪性相关偏见的再生产，表明生成过程中的系统性偏见具有跨模态传播特性，从而凸显出对生成式AI伦理与公平性评估机制的迫切需求。

机构: Rochester Institute of Technology(罗切斯特理工学院)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computers and Society (cs.CY)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Emergent generative AI technologies, while remarkably beneficial across several tasks and domains, can suffer from unforeseen vulnerabilities and difficult-to-anticipate failure modes. Such failure modes can disparately affect vulnerable communities. This paper investigates two well-known vision language models (VLMs) and inspects how these models encode protected identities while generating images. We show that when VLMs are requested to transform human face images to reflect race identities (e.g., Hispanic, Black, White, or Asian) and sexual orientation (e.g., gay or straight), VLMs often comply with such requests. We demonstrate that compliance (and refusal) is non-deterministic, group-sensitive, and generated images are statistically distinguishable, often accentuating deep-seated stereotypes. We further show that representation biases introduced during image generation can re-emerge in textual reasoning and characterization tasks. Finally, we show that this worrisome finding is not limited to racial identity or sexual orientation, image generation can perpetuate bias around criminality, raising concerning possibilities of AI-assisted profiling.

[IR-0] REGER: Modeling inter-item Relations with Semantic IDs for Generative Recommendation

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37584
作者: Yuxi Huang,Silin Zhou,Chenhao Wang,Zihan Li,Gangming Guo,Pei Ke,Shen Gao,Shuo Shang
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 13 pages, 6 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Personalized recommendation depends on learning semantic and collaborative relations among items from online content and user interactions. Generative recommendation (GR) offers a promising paradigm by autoregressively generating discrete semantic IDs (SIDs) of items. However, randomly initialized SID token embeddings and GR models trained from scratch do not directly inherit the semantic relations inherent in items, while inter-item collaborative relations are learned largely implicitly through token-level attention and next-token supervision. To address this limitation, we propose REGER, a unified framework that explicitly incorporates inter-item relations into semantic pretraining, history encoding, and SID generation. We pretrain the GR model through generative semantic retrieval, enabling it to inherit inter-item semantic similarity by learning to generate semantic neighbors’ SIDs. We combine global attention with local attention aligned with SID boundaries to capture historical context and directed transitions between adjacent items. We further develop a theoretical framework for hierarchical preference decomposition over the SID prefix tree, proving an exact factorization of collaborative preference distributions and a weighted decomposition of item-level KL divergence into prefix-conditional KL divergences. Building on this analysis, we distill a discriminative teacher’s full conditional distributions over all legal next tokens at ground-truth prefixes along the target SID path, jointly optimizing this objective with cross-entropy. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over existing GR baselines and support the effectiveness of the proposed preference distillation.

Abstract:We present LCM-Promo, an LLM-based uplift model for promotion allocation. LCM-Promo is a task-specific Large Commerce Model (LCM): a finetuned LLM trained on transactional commerce data to predict user intent and promotion response. It learns monotonic promotion-response curves from production logs by interpreting single-token outputs as conversion-threshold probabilities, while conditioning on session context such as day and delivery shift. In a production A/B test on churn reactivation, LCM-Promo increased conversion by 1% and reduced promotion cost by 6% relative to the Segment-EMA production baseline.

[IR-2] Can Complementary Signals Bridge Similarity Islands? Manifold-Augmented Graph Embedding for Multimodal Recommendation NEURIPS2026

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37409
作者: Zhenye Yang,Jinpeng Chen,Wenbo Fu,Jun Ma,Huan Li,Qimin Zhou,Tao Wang,Li Sun,Senzhang Wang
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 33 pages, including references and appendices

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multimodal Recommender Systems (MMRS) leverage rich item features to mitigate data sparsity, yet similarity-driven graph construction and propagation can favor semantically similar substitutes over functionally related complements. When behavioral associations connect semantically distant items, complementary signals can remain geometrically isolated, yielding fragmented “Similarity Islands” and semantic drift when standard propagation is applied. To overcome these limitations, we propose MAGE (Manifold-Augmented Graph Embedding), a framework for personalized multimodal ranking that decouples complementarity modeling into offline geometric warping and online topological propagation. The offline phase enhances item representations by extracting complement-aware residual directions via a Soft Conceptor mechanism and injecting them under a local gap-preserving constraint, incorporating co-purchase evidence while controlling the magnitude of geometric perturbation. Synergistically, the online phase employs an asymmetric dual-stream GNN that treats visual features as stable anchors and augmented textual features as flexible probes, fused through a self-calibrated cross-modal mechanism to reconcile shared semantics and modality-specific residual cues. Extensive experiments on four Amazon datasets show that MAGE yields consistent improvements over strong multimodal recommendation baselines. Together with the supporting analyses in the appendix, these results suggest that geometry-aware augmentation can alleviate the semantic mismatch that arises in complementary recommendation settings. Our code is available at this https URL.

[IR-3] When Is Additional Retrieval Worthwhile? A Cost-Aware Study of Evidence Gain and Answer Reliability in RAG

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37358
作者: Zhouting Zhao
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can benefit from more sophisticated retrieval, but extra retrieval may be unnecessary for many questions and gains in evidence retrieval may not translate into faithful or correct answers. We study a cost-aware, two-action retrieval policy that chooses between a dense-retrieval-plus-reranking baseline and a hybrid lexical–dense retriever. Rather than classifying baseline retrieval as simply successful or unsuccessful, we estimate the question-specific incremental evidence-retrieval benefit of hybrid retrieval using features available before the routing decision. A regularized linear model and decision threshold are selected using document-grouped cross-validation and frozen prior to held-out evaluation. On 60 previously unseen QASPER training-split articles (188 questions, 169 evidence-evaluable), the policy triggers hybrid retrieval on 46 questions (24.5%) and obtains the same evidence Hit@10 as always-hybrid retrieval (78.70%, versus 76.92% for always-keep). Paired, paper-cluster bootstrap intervals do not establish a reliable utility advantage. We further compare generated answers from a 4-bit Qwen3-4B model under the three retrieval policies. Provisional answer-level assessments show no clear correctness or faithfulness improvement after partial review, despite the evidence-retrieval result. The generation assessments remain model-assisted and lack independent human validation. These results expose an important distinction between retrieving relevant evidence efficiently and improving the reliability of the generated answer. The work is presented as a reproducible empirical study, not a claim of statistically established answer-quality superiority.

[IR-4] LESSRec: Level-Specific History Modeling for Semantic ID-Based Recommendation

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37286
作者: Shangxin Yang,Zongwei Wang,Jing Long,Junliang Yu,Min Gao
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Semantic ID-based recommendation represents each item as a sequence of semantic tokens obtained through residual quantization. This paradigm generates the next item’s tokens autoregressively from coarse to fine, entailing each prediction attending to historical tokens at all semantic levels. However, our inference-time analysis reveals that historical tokens at the target-token’s semantic level tend to be more informative, whereas other levels can introduce interference. Motivated by these findings, we propose LESSRec that separately encodes the historical token sequence at each semantic level and restricts attention over historical tokens to the sequence at the target token’s semantic level during prediction. To complement these level-specific histories, LESSRec explicitly provides an item-level semantic sequence that represents each historical item’s overall semantics in chronological order. The decoder accesses the level-aligned token sequence and the item-level semantic sequence through two separate cross-attention branches and fuses their contexts. We further introduce LESSRec+, which uses separate encoders for different semantic-level histories with the same total parameter count to reduce encoder computation. Extensive experiments across three public datasets and three tokenizers demonstrate the recommendation effectiveness of LESSRec and LESSRec+, with efficiency analyses highlighting the computational benefits of LESSRec+.

作者: Mingzhe Lu,Jian Qin,Ruize Qin,Jinhao Liu,Yunpeng Li,Hang Su
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 9 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Narrative-driven recommendation allows users to express multifaceted needs through free-form text where stated preferences naturally qualify and condition one another. Existing methods typically treat narratives as flat keyword combinations or unconstrained generative queries, failing to capture how complex preferences hierarchically refine and contextualize each other. We propose the Preference Dependency Graph Framework (PDG-F), a narrative-driven recommendation framework centered on explicit preference dependencies. Specifically, PDG-A (PDG-Agent) first parses unstructured requests to organize user preferences and their mutual qualifications into a directed acyclic Preference Dependency Graph (PDG). Through this graph, candidate evidence from the open Web is acquired via directed path retrieval, and final recommendations are determined by topological path ranking. Comprehensive experiments across three diverse domains spanning English and Chinese contexts confirm that PDG-F consistently achieves superior recommendation performance over competitive baselines, open-domain retrieval agents, and frontier language models. Further diagnostic analyses show that our dependency-guided retrieval markedly raises the attainable candidate-pool ceiling, demonstrating the fundamental value of modeling preference dependencies in narrative-driven recommendation.

[IR-6] GradCO: Behavior-Aware Gradient-Conflict Offloading for Text-Based Person Anomaly Search

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37267
作者: Zhiheng Fu,Zixu Li,Zhiwei Chen,Jiale Huang,Fangxu Liu,Jinhe Bi,Yupeng Hu
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Text-based Person Anomaly Search (TPAS) retrieves a target pedestrian using natural-language descriptions of appearance and normal or anomalous behavior. Unlike conventional text-based person retrieval, TPAS must preserve identity cues while distinguishing fine-grained behaviors. It presents two challenges: same-identity, different-behavior hard negatives cause gradient conflict during granular alignment, while strong appearance cues can obscure weak behavioral evidence during aggregation. We propose GradCO (behavior-aware Gradient-Conflict Offloading), comprising three complementary components. Behavior-Aware Mixture-of-Experts (B-MoE) forms appearance, normal-behavior, and anomalous-behavior streams whose roles are learned from retrieval objectives without expert-specific semantic labels. Conflict Offload Learning (COL) uses pair-conditioned offload anchors in similarity computation to reduce the conflicting-gradient burden on the main text representations. Hierarchical Intent Alignment (HIA) aggregates expert similarities and features using query-conditioned weights. Experiments on five TPAS/TIPR benchmarks show GradCO significantly surpasses SOTA methods and validate our design.

Abstract:The SIGIR 2026 eCommerce Challenge Query Reformulation Task evaluates the reformulation of task-oriented queries into expressions suitable for product retrieval, followed by BM25-based retrieval. These queries often imply product needs through activity-level semantics, creating a lexical gap with catalog descriptions. Systems must preserve task intent while adapting the number of reformulations to the Automatic and Interactive protocols. We propose TaskBridge, a catalog-anchored framework comprising Catalog Semantic Anchoring, Unified Five-Candidate Rewriting, and Protocol-Aware Selection. It grounds queries in catalog vocabulary, generates five complementary reformulations, and selects one query for Automatic retrieval or up to four for Interactive retrieval using BM25 scores, query-product reranking, and weighted Jaccard overlap. The selected queries are independently executed using BM25 to produce results in the required six-column format. Experiments demonstrate improved retrieval effectiveness, with multiple complementary queries providing additional gains in the Interactive setting. TaskBridge achieved first place in the SIGIR 2026 eCommerce Challenge.

[IR-8] AutoRSE: Evaluating LLM Agents as Recommendation Engineers for Self-Evolving Recommender Systems

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37228
作者: Rui Tian,Yi Fang,Yejin Hua,Du Wang,Yuzhe Wang,Minxuan Shan,Zirui Ren,Xinyu Lin,Chongming Gao,Wenjie Wang,Fuli Feng
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注: 12 pages, 7 figures. Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recommender Systems Engineer Agents (RSE-Agents), which use LLM-based agents to autonomously improve recommendation algorithms, are emerging as a promising paradigm. However, their capabilities and limitations remain poorly understood due to the lack of a unified, standardized evaluation framework and systematic trajectory-level analysis. To address this gap, we introduce AutoRSE, an evaluation framework spanning six representative industrial-grade recommendation tasks, and conduct a large-scale empirical study of three frontier LLMs across three widely used agent harnesses. Our results show that RSE-Agents consistently enhance the performance of backbones on five of the six tasks, with an average relative improvement of 16.1%, indicating that they can already autonomously improve recommendation performance. However, trajectory-level analysis also reveals that current RSE-Agents function primarily as engineering optimizers rather than algorithmic improvers: their gains are largely driven by hyperparameter tuning, training strategies, and model ensembling, while genuine algorithmic innovations are rare. Since the largest gains in recommender systems often stem from algorithmic advances, this behavior underscores a fundamental limitation of current RSE-Agents. To probe this limitation, we perform idea-injection experiments and show that agents equipped with innovative ideas from frontier research or human experts achieve substantially larger improvements than those relying on self-generated ideas. These results suggest that idea generation is a central bottleneck of current RSE-Agents, highlights a key direction for the future recommendation system research. Our implementation is publicly available on GitHub: this https URL.

Abstract:Graph-based Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) indexes, such as HNSW, are the backbone of modern vector search. While vector quantization is widely adopted to reduce the memory required to store data vectors, the graph’s edge structure increasingly dominates total memory usage. Compressing these adjacency lists for online search presents a critical system challenge: because decompression occurs during query processing, i.e., while navigating the graph, memory savings cannot come at the expense of query latency. In this paper, we present a compression technique explicitly tailored for live HNSW routing. By applying offline graph permutations to artificially induce structural locality, we enable the use of SIMD-accelerated integer compressors, such as Stream VByte, for rapid on-the-fly decompression. Evaluated across diverse real-world workloads, we significantly outperform the current state of the art in both compression ratio and query latency. Our experimental results show that we achieve compression ratios up to 52.7% with negligible penalties in latency compared to the uncompressed baseline. Abstract:Click-through rate (CTR) prediction relies on historical behaviors and contextual features to estimate clicks on a target item. Abstract:Web retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) splits a page into fixed-size text chunks or, in recent visual pipelines, screenshot tiles, and the retrieved item serves at once as the unit of indexing, ranking, and reading. Abstract:Next-item prediction is inherently ambiguous: a single interaction history often admits multiple plausible continuations across distinct catalogue regions. Abstract:Coordinating multiple recommendation objectives (e.g., click and conversion) is critical for real-world generative recommendation (GR). Despite its simplicity, we theoretically prove that KL-MOPD strictly outperforms vanilla MOPD in the additive joint recommendation objective under mild conditions. Moreover, KL-MOPD is plug-and-play and computationally efficient, requiring only a one-time pre-training weight calibration with negligible training overhead. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks, a billion-scale industrial dataset, and online A/B tests on our e-commerce advertising platform demonstrate that KL-MOPD significantly improves both individual and joint recommendation performance. Abstract:When the sources retrieved for a query disagree, the right response depends on why they disagree: a question with several valid answers, a contested topic, stale information and a false source each call for different behaviour. Abstract:Generative recommendation (GR) models for ranking typically adopt a fast-thinking direct prediction paradigm with strong practical efficiency. Abstract:As recommendation scenarios become increasingly diverse and multimodal information grows more prevalent, effectively modeling cross-scenario user preferences and multimodal semantics has become a critical challenge in recommender systems. Specifically, the collaborative branch learns structured collaborative preference representations through CANDECOMP/PARAFAC (CP) decomposition of user-scenario-item interactions and residual quantization, thereby capturing cross-scenario commonalities and scenario-specific differences. The multimodal branch leverages the learned user and scenario preferences to guide adaptive modality fusion; additionally, item-level contrastive learning aligns collaborative item preference representations with multimodal representations to facilitate effective collaboration between the two branches. Abstract:Generative recommendation (GR) predicts the next item through its semantic ID (SID). Users’ decisions also varied with the agent they faced, but predictions hardly reflected this: users cooperated more with the Agreeableness agent than with the Extraversion agent (70.6% vs. 54.5%), whereas predicted cooperation was nearly identical (64.5% vs. 63.1%). Users also cooperated more with an agent when they themselves scored higher on that agent’s trait, whereas predicted cooperation barely changed with these scores. Dialogue-based predictions should therefore weigh users’ statements by their earlier decisions and the agent they face.

Abstract:Grip pressure, including contact force and its distribution across the hand, is central to skilled grasping but is not directly visible. This makes it difficult to teach, learn, and self-correct in grip-dependent motor tasks, where verbal instruction and tactile demonstration provide only partial guidance and no real-time, spatially resolved feedback tied to the learner’s own grip. Using an instrumented glove, we compare pressure feedback visualizations for such guidance, evaluating how visualization type and, secondarily, sensor-region mapping shape pressure-matching performance in novices. In a study using baseball and table tennis as representative grip tasks (N=28), we find that a continuous gradient visualization produces significantly more accurate pressure matches and lower gaze entropy than a discrete bar display, despite participants perceiving the bar as more precise for pressure magnitude. Perceived precision and objective performance therefore diverged: the encoding participants judged more precise was not the one they matched more accurately with. Grip-tailored sensor-region mappings further reduced perceived temporal demand and effort, although this subjective workload advantage did not extend to objective matching accuracy. Overall, continuous pressure feedback supported more accurate grip matching and more concentrated viewing, and we present design considerations for real-time pressure feedback in motor skill guidance.

Abstract:The Reality-Virtuality (RV) continuum helps in describing the relationship between physical and computer-generated environments. However, the increasing number of Extended Reality (XR) paradigms introduces new technologies. Their characteristics cannot be completely represented by a single real-virtual dimension. It can be noted that XR systems not only vary in their proportion of real and virtual content but also adds, suppresses, or transforms information available to the user. This work proposes a framework for characterizing seven XR realities, namely Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Mixed Reality (MR), Augmented Virtuality (AV), Phenomenal Reality (PR), Annexing Reality (AnR), and Diminished Reality (DR). It uses a two-dimensional extension of the conventional 1D RV continuum. The first dimension helps in identification of the position of an XR technology between real and virtual environments. The second dimension captures information addition and subtraction. The proposed approach gives a qualitative basis for comparing existing and emerging XR paradigms within a unified XR framework.
